Punjab Police Constable Selection Process 2026

The Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of three stages:

Stage-I: Computer Based Test (CBT)

The CBT comprises two papers:

Paper-I (100 marks, 2 hours duration)

Section Topics Number of Questions
General Awareness Constitution, Central & State Legislature, History, Geography, Culture & Economy of Punjab, Health & Nutrition, Current Affairs 35
Quantitative Aptitude and Numerical Skills Simplification, Average, Decimal & Fractions, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Profit & Loss, Simple Interest, Time & Work 20
Mental Ability & Logical Reasoning Number & Letter Series, Sequencing, Statements & Conclusions, Pattern Completion, Order & Ranking, Direction & Distances, Relationship Problems 20
English Language Skills Reading Comprehension, Punjabi to English Translation, Sentence rearrangement & correction, Error Spotting, Fill in the Blanks, Spelling Correction, Vocabulary 10
Punjabi Language Skills ਸ਼ੁੱਧ/ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ, ਸਮਾਨਾਰਥਕ/ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਖਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਹਾਵਰੇ, ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ, etc. 10
Digital Literacy & Awareness Fundamentals of Computers, MS Office, Internet, Email Communication, Mobile Phones 05
Total   100

Paper-II (50 marks, 1 hour duration) – Mandatory Qualifying Paper

  • Punjabi Language test of Matriculation standard
  • Qualifying criteria: 50% marks (25 out of 50)
  • Note: Marks obtained in Paper-II will NOT be counted for merit calculation

Minimum Qualifying Marks (Paper-I after normalization):

  • SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 35%
  • Other categories: 40%

Important Points:

  • No negative marking
  • Normalization will be applied as CBT conducted in multiple shifts
  • Answer key will be published after exam; candidates can raise objections within 48 hours (Rs. 50 per objection)

Stage-II: Physical Screening Test (PST) & Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

Candidates qualifying Paper-I and Paper-II will be shortlisted for Stage-II based on merit.

Physical Screening Test (PST):

Candidate Category Physical Tests
Male (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 1600 meters race in 6 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.80 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 1.10 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Male (above 35 years) • 1400 meters walk/run in 12 min (1 chance)
• 10 Full Squats within 3 minutes (1 chance)
Female/Transgender (including Ex-servicemen below 35 years) • 800 meters race in 4 min 30 sec (1 chance)
• Long Jump 3.00 meters (3 chances)
• High Jump 0.95 meters (3 chances)
Ex-Servicemen Female (above 35 years) • 800 meters run in 6 minutes (1 chance)

Physical Measurement Test (PMT):

  • Height measurement as per eligibility criteria mentioned above
  • Candidates not meeting minimum height will be disqualified

Note: Pregnant female candidates may request postponement of PST/PMT by submitting medical certificate from government hospital. One opportunity will be given within 6 months after delivery.

Stage-III: Document Scrutiny

Candidates qualifying Stage-II will be called for document verification. Required documents include:

  • Matriculation certificate (proof of age)
  • 10+2 or equivalent certificate
  • Punjabi qualification proof
  • Domicile certificate (for female candidates applying under General category)
  • Category certificate (SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen, etc.)
  • NOC (for serving government employees)
  • Photo identity proof (Aadhaar, Driving License, PAN, Voter ID, or Passport)

Note: Candidates unable to produce original documents will not be considered for selection.

Punjab Police Constable Apply Online 2026

Step-by-step Application Process:

  1. Visit the official recruitment portal https://iur.ls/punjabpolicerecruitment2026
  2. Click on "Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026" link under latest notifications
  3. Complete registration with basic details and generate login credentials
  4. Log in and fill the online application form with personal, educational, and cadre preference details
  5. For District Cadre, fill 15 district preferences in order of priority (selected candidates will not be posted in their home district)
  6. Upload scanned copies of:
    • Recent colored passport size photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm) against white background (80-200 KB JPEG)
    • Signature (80-200 KB JPEG)
    • Relevant certificates
  7. Pay application fee online through available payment modes
  8. Submit the form and download/print the final submitted application for future reference
  9. Note your Registration ID and keep checking portal for updates

Important: Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues.

How to Apply for Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Applications must only be submitted in the online mode on https:///ur.ls/punjabpolicerecruitment2026.
  • Candidates would be first required to fill a registration form followed by the Application Form, which in turn would be linked to the fee payment gateway.
  • Candidates for the District Cadre shall be required to fill in 15 district preferences to which the candidate would want to be allocated in case of final selection.
  • District allocation would be made on the basis of merit position in Merit List and the availability of vacancies in the preferred District. As per Punjab Govt. Instructions No. 6/75/2019-7H3/1745 dated 21.05.2020, selected candidate shall not be posted in their home district.
  • Applicants are advised to read the instructions, as given on the Recruitment Portal, carefully, before filling-up the application form.
  • Incomplete application shall be rejected outright and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • The applicants are advised to fill all details, including their correct and active email address and mobile number, in the online application.
  • Applicants must ensure that they have access to good internet facility with reasonable speed and facility to ensure proper completion of application process including online payment of fee.

12604 Scientific Assistant (B) – Pathology Technician B.Sc. with minimum 60% marks + PG Diploma in DMLT with minimum 60% marks OR B.Sc. (MLT) with minimum 60% marks Nil

NFC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process varies by post code:

  • Post Codes 12601, 12603, 12604 – Interview Based: Selection on the basis of Personal Interview. If response is more, NFC may conduct a Screening Test (75 MCQs, 90 minutes, +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect) to restrict candidates called for interview.
  • Post Codes 12602, 12605, 12606 – Three Stage Process:
    • Stage 1 – Preliminary Test (1 hour, OMR-based): 50 MCQs – Mathematics (20), Science (20), General Awareness (10). +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 40% (General), 30% (Reserved categories).
    • Stage 2 – Advanced Test (2 hours): 50 MCQs from relevant discipline. +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 30% (General), 20% (Reserved). Merit list prepared based on Stage 2 marks only. Both stages conducted in a single session as Section A & B.
    • Stage 3 – Skill Test (Go/No-Go basis): Up to 5 times the number of vacancies shortlisted from Stage 2. Candidates clearing Skill Test empanelled in order of Stage 2 merit.

Post Code Post Name Application Fee Fee Exemption
12601 Scientific Officer (C) – GDMO ₹500/- SC/ST, Women
12602 Nurse (A) ₹150/- SC/ST, PwBD, Women
12603 Scientific Assistant (B) – Radiographer ₹150/- SC/ST, Women
12604 Scientific Assistant (B) – Pathology Technician ₹150/- SC/ST, Women
12605 Pharmacist (B) ₹100/- SC/ST, PwBD, Women
12606 Technician (B) – X-ray Technician ₹100/- SC/ST, Women

Payment mode: Online only through BharatKosh / Non-Tax Receipt Portal (NTRP) at https://bharatkosh.gov.in. Fee once paid is non-refundable.

Examination Centres

Examinations are tentatively scheduled to be conducted at Hyderabad (Telangana), Mumbai (Maharashtra), Rawatbhata (Rajasthan) and Pazhayakayal (Tamil Nadu). Candidates may indicate their preferred city in the application form. NFC reserves the right to add or delete centres without assigning any reason.

How to Apply for NFC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official NFC recruitment website https://recruit.nfc.gov.in (available from 21 March 2026, 10:00 hrs).
  2. Read the advertisement and instructions carefully before filling the application.
  3. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.
  4. Keep the following documents ready in PDF format for uploading:
    • SSC/10th Standard Certificate
    • HSC/12th Certificate
    • Qualifying certificate (Degree/Diploma/Certificate for respective post)
    • Registration Certificate (as applicable)
    • Caste/PwBD/EWS certificate (if applicable)
    • Experience/Training certificate (as applicable)
    • Application fee payment receipt (if applicable)
    • Passport-size photograph (JPEG, 165×125 pixels, max 50 KB, white background)
    • Signature (JPEG, 80×125 pixels, max 20 KB)
  5. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through BharatKosh/NTRP before initiating the online application.
  6. Fill all details in the online application form correctly as per Matriculation certificate.
  7. Enter fee payment details in the 'Details of Fee Paid' column and submit the application before 18 April 2026 (17:00 hrs).
  8. A copy of the submitted application will be sent to your registered email ID in PDF format – preserve it till the selection process is completed.

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by concerned Regulatory Authorities in India.
  • Only one application per post; separate applications required for each post if applying for multiple posts.
  • After final submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies must submit NOC at the time of Interview/Skill Test.
  • SC/ST outstation candidates called for Tests/Interview/Skill Test will be reimbursed to-and-fro sleeper class/second-class railway fare by shortest route (subject to production of tickets); fare for first 30 km shall be borne by candidates.
  • Appointment is subject to Medical fitness conducted by NFC.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as notified by the Government.
  • Select list/Wait list validity is one year from the date of publication of results.
  • Candidates must regularly check https://www.nfc.gov.in for all updates; no information will be sent by post/courier.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.
  • Beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements forging NFC/DAE name/logo; NFC does not ask for any payment other than the prescribed application fee.
  • For any clarification, contact: [email protected] (with Registration Number, registered email ID, mobile number, name, date of birth, and post applied for).

The official notification for the Indian Army Agniveer Vacancy 2026 has been released, announcing over 25,000+ (Expected) vacancies across various positions including GD, Tradesman, Technical, Soldier Pharma, and more.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in class 10th Board Exam and are awaiting declaration of results are also eligible to apply provided they fulfill all other Qualification Required. Such candidates, however, shall only be selected when they produce the original marksheet during the Phase II of recruitment process.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 17 ½ years
  • Maximum Age: 22 years
  • Candidates born between 01 Jul 2005 to 01 Jul 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply.

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Upper Age limit will be relaxable upto 30 years of age (as on date of joining training) in respect of widows of Defence personnel who have died in harness.
  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

Physical Standards

  • Height: 162 cms.
  • Chest Expansion: The candidate should be capable of chest expansion of 05 cms.
  • Weight: Weight standards are based on BMI as per the chart below.

  • North East Region: Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya and Assam.
  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).
  • School Character Certificate.
  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.
  • NCC Certificate (if applicable).
  • Sports Certificate (if applicable).
  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Eligibility Criteria – FCRI Walk-In Interview 2026

1) Trainee Graduate Engineers (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation

  • Educational Qualification​

    • Full‑time degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant discipline (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Electrical Sciences).

    • Degree must be from UGC/AICTE‑recognized Universities/Institutions.

    • Either 4‑year regular bachelor’s degree programme, or Engineering degree through lateral entry after full‑time Engineering Diploma in relevant discipline from recognized Polytechnic.

    • Minimum First Class with 60% or more aggregate in qualifying degree (and in diploma, if applicable).

  • Experience​

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant areas as specified for each discipline (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Instrumentation/Electrical Sciences) – e.g. calibration/testing, construction & maintenance, O&M of substations, calibration of electro‑technical parameters, etc.

    • Level‑1:

      • Less than 1 year experience in relevant areas, including candidates with at least 2 months of relevant internship / practical exposure.

2) ITI/NCVT Trades (Level‑1 & Level‑2) – Machinist / Fitter / Welder / Plumber / Electrician / AC & Refrigeration

  • Educational Qualification​

    • ITI with NCVT in relevant trade: Machinist, Fitter, Welder, Plumber, Electrician, AC & Refrigeration.

    • Minimum 55% marks or more in ITI/NCVT.

  • Experience​

    • Level‑1:

      • Freshers or candidates with less than 1 year experience in relevant trade areas (shop floor, fabrication, installation/maintenance, troubleshooting, etc.).

    • Level‑2:

      • Minimum 1 year experience in relevant trade areas as described (workshop/machining, plumbing & piping systems, electrical fault rectification, AC & refrigeration systems, etc.).

No explicit upper age limit is mentioned in these walk‑in notifications; selection is primarily based on qualification, relevant experience and performance in the walk‑in interview / test.

Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) under Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Department of Space, Government of India has released the VSSC Authorised Medical Officer & Dermatologist Recruitment 2026 notification for contract-based positions of Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) at Parassala, Authorised Medical Officer (Homeopathy) at Nemom, and Dermatologist in Thiruvananthapuram.
 
Candidates must possess MBBS with permanent Medical Council Registration for Allopathy, BHMS with Registration in the Council of Indian Systems of Medicine for Homeopathy, and MD/DNB Dermatology or PG Diploma in Dermatology with additional qualification registration for the Dermatologist post, along with minimum two years of relevant experience after registration/graduation and their own well-equipped consultation room with good facilities at the specified locations (Parassala / Nemom / Thiruvananthapuram city). All these latest ISRO doctor jobs on contract basis are offered initially for 6 months (extendable with mutual consent) with attractive remuneration ranging from ₹12,000–₹54,000 per month for Authorised Medical Officer (Allopathy) based on files assigned, fixed ₹12,500 per month for Homeopathy Medical Officer, and ₹400 per consultation for Dermatologist, making this one of the attractive government medical positions for experienced doctors looking for opportunities in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

CSEB Kerala Various Posts 2026 Vacancy Details

The vacancies for CSEB Kerala Recruitment 2026 are spread across multiple cooperative banks and societies under 7 advertisement numbers. The post-wise and advertisement-wise details are as follows:

Advt No. Category / Post Name Number of Post
14/2026 Data Entry Operator 3

Note: Each advertisement covers vacancies in multiple cooperative banks/societies across various districts of Kerala. Candidates can apply for one or more banks within a single advertisement. Complete bank-wise and district-wise vacancy details are available in the official notification PDF.

Eligibility Criteria for CSEB Kerala Various Posts 2026

1. Age Limit

Candidates must have completed 18 years and must not have exceeded 40 years as on 01/01/2026.

  • SC/ST candidates: Upper age relaxation of 5 years
  • OBC/EWS candidates: 3 years relaxation
  • Persons with Disabilities (40% or more): 10 years relaxation
  • Widows: 5 years relaxation
  • Ex-Servicemen: As per Kerala Government rules

2. Educational Qualification (Post-wise)

Post (Advt No.) Essential Qualification
Data Entry Operator (14/2026) (i) Bachelor's Degree from any recognised university. (ii) Certificate in Data Entry Course from a Central/Kerala Government recognised institution. (iii) Minimum one year work experience as Data Entry Operator in a recognised institution.
System Administrator (13/2026) MCA / B.Tech. (Computer Science or Electronic Communication or Information Technology). Minimum 3 years working experience as System Administrator or equivalent post in any recognised institution is desirable.
Junior Clerk/Cashier – Class-2 to Class-7 Banks (12/2026) SSLC or equivalent qualification + Junior Diploma in Co-operation (Personal Cooperative Training Course conducted by the Board) as basic qualification. Alternatively: B.Com with Co-operation as main subject, or Degree from any recognised university, or Cooperative Higher Diploma (HDC/HDC&BM/HDCM by NCCT/Kerala State Cooperative Union), or B.Sc (Co-operation & Banking) from Kerala Agricultural University.
Junior Clerk/Cashier – Special Grade, Class-I Banks (11/2026) Same as above (12/2026) – SSLC + Junior Diploma in Co-operation. Additional qualifications same as 12/2026.
Junior Clerk/Cashier – Urban Grade Banks (10/2026) Same as above (12/2026) – SSLC + Junior Diploma in Co-operation. Additional qualifications same as 12/2026.
Assistant Secretary / Chief Accountant (9/2026) Bachelor's Degree with minimum 50% marks in all subjects + Cooperative Higher Diploma (HDC/HDC&BM or HDCM by NCCT or Junior Diploma in Co-operation completed from the Board's Personal Cooperative Training Course) OR B.Sc/M.Sc (Co-operation & Banking) from Kerala Agricultural University OR B.Com with Co-operation as main subject with minimum 50% marks from any recognised university recognised in Kerala.
Secretary (8/2026) (i) Degree + HDC&BM with 7 years experience as Accountant or above in a Cooperative Bank. OR (ii) B.Sc (Co-operation & Banking) from Agricultural University with 5 years experience as Accountant or above. OR (iii) MBA/M.Com (Finance) or Chartered Accountant membership with 3 years experience in Banking Sector and cooperative qualifications. OR (iv) B.Com (Co-operation) with 7 years experience as Accountant or above in a Cooperative Bank. (As per G.O.(Rt) No.220/2022/Co-Op dated 29/03/2022)

Salaey for CSEB Kerala Various Posts 2026

Category / Post Name Pay Scale (Scale of Pay)
Data Entry Operator ₹14,270–₹37,880 / ₹17,360–₹44,650 / ₹18,300–₹46,830 (varies by bank)
System Administrator ₹26,580–₹63,790
Junior Clerk/Cashier (Class-2 to Class-7 Banks) ₹7,900–₹19,300 to ₹19,250–₹51,650 (varies by bank)
Junior Clerk/Cashier – Special Grade, Class-I Banks ₹13,480–₹36,060 to ₹17,590–₹45,570 (varies by bank)
Junior Clerk/Cashier – Urban Grade Banks ₹18,300–₹46,830
Assistant Secretary / Chief Accountant ₹28,000–₹66,470 to ₹29,500–₹69,250 (varies by bank)
Secretary ₹15,110–₹39,700 to ₹23,310–₹57,340 (varies by bank)

Selection Process for CSEB Kerala Various Posts 2026

The selection for all posts under CSEB Kerala Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process:

  • Written Examination: 100 objective-type questions carrying 1 mark each (total 100 marks). The examination will be conducted online (CBT) or via OMR as per the specific advertisement.
  • Interview: Conducted by the respective cooperative bank/society. Maximum 20 marks are allotted for the interview. A minimum of 4 marks is required to qualify in the interview. The cutoff for the interview is 16 marks out of the remaining marks.
  • Final Merit List: Prepared by the Cooperative Service Examination Board based on the combined score of written exam and interview.

Note: The exam centre for Advertisement No. 13/2026 (System Administrator) will be only in Kozhikode district.

Application Fee for CSEB Kerala Various Posts 2026

Category First Bank/Society Each Additional Bank/Society
General / Age-Relaxed candidates (including those eligible for age relaxation) ₹150 ₹50 per additional bank
SC / ST candidates ₹50 ₹50 per additional bank

Note: 18% GST is applicable on examination fee as per Kerala Government Order G.O.(P) No.17/2024/Co-Op dated 13/08/2024. Fee must be paid online. Applications sent by post will not be accepted.

How to Apply for CSEB Kerala Various Posts Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for CSEB Kerala Various Posts 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: cseb.kerala.gov.in
  2. Candidates who have not yet done One-Time Registration must first complete the One-Time Registration on the CSEB portal.
  3. Already registered candidates can log in using their existing profile credentials.
  4. Read the official notification carefully for the respective advertisement number (8/2026 to 14/2026).
  5. Select the desired bank(s)/society(ies) and post(s) for which you wish to apply.
  6. Fill in the application form with accurate details and upload required documents.
  7. Pay the prescribed examination fee online along with applicable 18% GST.
  8. Submit the application online and take a printout from the "My Application" section for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for more than one bank/society under a single advertisement. Applications received by post will not be accepted. Candidates must possess the required educational qualifications before the last date of application (04/04/2026).

SECL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026

SECL Apprentice eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification and other conditions. All conditions must be fulfilled as on 31.03.2026.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Particulars Details
Minimum Age 18 years (must be completed as on 31.03.2026)
Upper Age Limit No upper age limit prescribed
Age Relaxation Not Applicable (Nil for all categories)

Note: The SECL Apprentice 2026 notification does not provide any age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen or any other category. Only the minimum age requirement of 18 years as on the last date of application (31 March 2026) must be met. Candidates failing to satisfy the minimum age criterion will be ineligible.

SECL Apprentice Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SECL Apprenticeship 2026 are stream-specific and must be from Government-recognised institutions in full-time regular mode only.

  • Graduate Apprentices: 4-year B.E./B.Tech / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / BCA in relevant discipline.
  • Technician Apprentices: 3-year Diploma in relevant engineering branch (after 10th or 2 years after 12th with lateral entry allowed; 1-year Diploma not permitted).

Candidates must be registered on NATS 2.0 portal and should not have undergone apprenticeship training earlier or completed one-year employment/service.

SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026

The SECL Apprentice Selection Process 2026 is purely merit-based:

  • Shortlisting on the basis of Date of Passing (earlier passing gets higher rank)
  • Tie-breaker: Percentage of marks in Degree/Diploma → 12th/10th marks → Date of Birth
  • Two separate seniority lists: Level-1 (Chhattisgarh & Madhya Pradesh) and Level-2 (other states)
  • Document Verification + Medical Fitness Examination (as per Mines Rules 1955 / Apprenticeship Rules 1992)

SECL Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected candidates will receive the following monthly stipend as per Rule 11(2) of Apprenticeship Rules 1992:

  • Graduate Apprentices: ₹12,300 per month
  • Technician Apprentices: ₹10,900 per month

50% stipend paid by SECL and 50% by Government through DBT in Aadhaar-linked bank account.

How to Apply for SECL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for SECL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 by following the steps given below.

  1. First register on NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in
  2. Visit official SECL website www.secl-cil.in → HRD → Apprentice section and click on the online application link
  3. Complete SECL registration using your NATS-registered email ID
  4. Login and fill all mandatory details in the application form (Basic Information, Educational Details, Photograph & Signature, Bank Details)
  5. Upload required documents (SSC/HSC certificates, Degree/Diploma marksheets & certificates, NATS registration document, Aadhaar, etc.)
  6. Verify all details and click Final Submit before 31.03.2026 (12:00 Midnight)
  7. Take printout of the submitted application for future reference

Important Instructions

  • Only candidates registered on NATS 2.0 portal are eligible to apply
  • Applications sent by post, email or any other mode will not be accepted
  • No change in any data filled in the application form will be entertained after submission
  • Selected candidates will NOT be absorbed in any regular employment in SECL
  • No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for document verification or training
  • Medical fitness certificate must be issued after the date of this notification
  • OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 only will be accepted
  • SECL reserves the right to increase/decrease seats or cancel the entire process without notice
  • All announcements will be made only on the official SECL website; candidates are advised to visit regularly

Eligibility Criteria

  • Disc Code 101 – Technician Apprentice (Mechanical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 102 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 103 – Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 104 – Technician Apprentice (Civil): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 105 – Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 106 – Technician Apprentice (Electronics): 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 107 – Trade Apprentice (Fitter): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 108 – Trade Apprentice (Electrician): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 109 – Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 110 – Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 111 – Trade Apprentice (Machinist): Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
  • Disc Code 112 – Graduate Apprentice (BA/B.Com/B.Sc/BBA): Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Disc Code 113 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Fresher): Class 12th (but below graduate) with minimum 50% marks (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% marks (SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognized Institute/Board.
  • Disc Code 114 – Trade Apprentice – Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders): Class 12th (but below graduate) plus Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.
  • Qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course. Qualifications acquired through Part-time / Correspondence / Distance Learning mode are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2022 and 28.02.2026.
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator), qualification must be acquired between 01.04.2021 and 28.02.2026.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB or equivalent are NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Diploma holders under lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year) are also eligible subject to prescribed percentage in aggregate of all semesters.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second training shall not be in the same trade.

Salary / Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973 and Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time.
  • The exact stipend amount is not specified in the notification; candidates are advised to refer to the latest Apprentices Rules for updated stipend rates.

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years
  • Maximum Age: 24 Years
  • SC/ST candidates: Age relaxation of 5 years (maximum up to 29 years)
  • OBC-NCL candidates: Age relaxation of 3 years (maximum up to 27 years)
  • PwBD candidates: Age relaxation of up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD; up to 13 years for OBC-NCL PwBD)
  • Cutoff/Reckoning date for age criteria: 28.02.2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee has been mentioned in the official notification.
  • Candidates apply through NAPS / NATS portals; any charges levied by the portal (if any) are not specified in this notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 26/03/2026 up to 5:00 PM
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID / IOCL website
Cutoff / Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for the selection process.
  • There will be no written test or interview.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the respective post.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification.
  • Shortlisted candidates must complete a Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test and be adjudged medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format.
  • Candidates whose documents and Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued an Offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting shall be filled by eligible candidates from the merit cum panel list for the same opportunity.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must apply only for ONE discipline code. Applications for more than one discipline code will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must submit applications only against vacancies notified under the states of Western Region (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, UT of Daman & Diu, UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli). Selection of training locations outside notified states will result in rejection.
  • Candidate profile on the portal must be 100% complete (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category, etc.).
  • The candidature of the applicant shall be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • Any false or incorrect information furnished at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature and liability for criminal prosecution.
  • Candidates should maintain the same registered email ID and mobile number till completion of apprenticeship training.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to fulfilling standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • PwBD candidates are NOT eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 110, 111.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for the respective States/UT.
  • No. of seats indicated is tentative and may increase or decrease at the absolute discretion of management.
  • Upon completion of the Apprenticeship period, IOCL shall have NO obligation to offer employment, nor can an Apprentice claim the right for employment.
  • A minimum one-year gap between two apprenticeship trainings is required, provided the previous training is completed.
  • All future correspondence and latest information shall be shared only on IOCL website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships.
  • For OBC-NCL category, candidates must submit a latest caste certificate not more than 12 months old from 28.02.2026 in the Proforma prescribed by Govt. of India.
  • Canvassing of any kind shall disqualify the candidate.

How to Apply

  • Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online only through the NAPS/NATS Portal.
  • For Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator): Register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ (NAPS)
  • For Technician Apprentice (Diploma) and Graduate Apprentice: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php (NATS)
  • After registration, login to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID/Email ID and APPLY for apprenticeship openings using the following Establishment IDs of IOCL (Marketing Division) – Western Region:
    • NATS Establishment ID: WMHMCC000053
    • NAPS Establishment ID: E01172700332
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 (10:00 AM) to 26.03.2026 (5:00 PM).
  • No other means or mode of application will be accepted.
  • Ensure your profile is 100% complete with Personal Details, Educational Details, and Category before applying.
  • Before applying, keep ready: PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details with Cheque Book (name printed), and scanned copies of Educational Qualification Certificates.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well in advance before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s) / Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD and meeting prescribed eligibility criteria must apply through NAPS/NATS Portal.

SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026

The SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026 consists of the following stages:

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET):
    • HC (Lab Assistant) & HC (Physiotherapy Assistant): Male – 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female – 800 m in 4 min
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): Male – 4.8 km in 24 min; Female – 2.4 km in 18 min
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET
  • Stage I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Height and chest measurement as per category-wise norms (General/UR/OBC/EWS: Male 165 cm, Female 155 cm; chest for males 75–80 cm; relaxations for ST, NE States, Garhwali, Kumaoni, Dogra, Maratha, J&K/Ladakh candidates).
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test):
    • HC (Lab Assistant & Physiotherapy Assistant): 150 marks, 3 hours, 150 MCQs – Part I (50 marks): GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi; Part II (100 marks): Technical Subject. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): 100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs – GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
  • Stage III – Documentation & Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): Top 3 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) from written exam will be called. Final merit list drawn on written exam marks.

NaBFID Senior Analyst Selection Process 2026

The selection process differs for Regular and Contract basis appointments as follows.

Regular Basis: The selection process comprises an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. If fewer applications are received for any stream, the Bank may change the process to Shortlisting-cum-Interview. The online exam consists of 50 objective-type questions (Professional Knowledge) carrying 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes. There is a negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for UR/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates. Final selection is based on Online Exam (70% weightage) and Interview (30% weightage).

Contract Basis: The selection process is Shortlisting-cum-Interview. If a large number of applications are received, the Bank may conduct an Online Exam. A Psychometric Test and Group Discussion may also be conducted as additional assessment tools. Interviews will be held at Mumbai only.

SSB ASI Selection Process 2026

The selection process for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 will be conducted in multiple stages to assess the physical fitness, knowledge and medical standards of the candidates. Only those who qualify each stage of the SSB Assistant Sub Inspector selection process 2026 will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Measurement of height, chest and weight as per SSB ASI paramedical standards. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed physical standards will be disqualified at this stage.
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Running and other endurance events as per Sashastra Seema Bal norms for Assistant Sub Inspector posts (pattern similar to other SSB non‑GD posts; details are given in the notification).
  • Written Examination: Objective type written test/CBT consisting of questions from General Knowledge, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, General English/Hindi and technical/paramedical subject related to the ASI post.
  • Skill/Trade Test (if applicable): Practical test to assess professional skills for posts like Radiographer, Pharmacist, OT Technician and Dental Technician as per SSB ASI recruitment rules.
  • Document Verification: Verification of original documents such as educational certificates, diplomas, experience certificates, caste certificate, age proof, identity proof and other required documents.
  • Medical Examination: Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME), if required, to check fitness as per SSB medical standards for paramilitary service.
  • Final Merit List: Preparation of final merit list of candidates qualified in all stages, based on marks in written/technical tests and subject to qualifying PET, PST and medical standards.

  • Stage I – INET is a computer-based examination with 100 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • The Stage I question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness.
  • The standard of Stage I question paper is that of 10+2, and syllabus and sample papers are available on the official website.
  • The duration of Stage I examination is one hour, and candidates are required to pass in all sections as well as in aggregate; pass marks in each section and aggregate are determined by the Indian Navy.
  • Negative marking is applicable in Stage I – one fourth (0.25) marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Centre allocation for INET (online examination) is at the discretion of the Indian Navy.
  • In case of extraneous circumstances causing non-conduct of INET or as per service requirement, Indian Navy reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on marks obtained in qualifying examinations (10th/12th board exams).
  • Results of Stage I – INET (Pass/Fail) along with marks scored will be uploaded on the candidate’s online dashboard.
  • Candidates eligible for Stage II as per age criteria will be shortlisted for SSR (Medical) 02/2027 batch based on marks obtained in Stage I – INET 2026.
  • Shortlisting for Stage II will be carried out state wise, and cut-off marks for next stage will vary from state to state as vacancies are allotted state-wise.
  • If candidates with the same percentage exceed required numbers, shortlisting will be done based on Date of Birth, with earlier DOB (fewer chances) given priority.
  • Sponsor candidates and NCC ‘C’ certificate holders who upload original sponsor and NCC certificates during Stage I application and whose certificates are verified will be exempted from Stage I – INET and will be directly issued call-up for Stage II based on eligibility.
  • Stage II begins with Physical Fitness Test (PFT), which is mandatory; candidates undergoing PFT do so at their own risk.
  • PFT standards for male candidates are: 1.6 km run in 6 min 30 sec, 20 Squats (Uthak Baithak), 15 Push-ups and 15 Bent Knee Sit-ups.
  • The Stage II written exam is conducted only for candidates who qualify the PFT and consists of 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each.
  • The Stage II written exam question paper is bilingual (Hindi & English) and comprises four sections: English, Science, Biology and General Awareness, with 10+2 level standard and one-hour duration.
  • Candidates must pass in all sections and in aggregate in the Stage II written exam; pass marks are set by the Indian Navy.
  • Recruitment Medical Examination is carried out for candidates who qualify PFT; candidates who qualify Recruitment Medical are considered for the merit list.
  • Candidates found medically unfit in Recruitment Medical may appeal for review at a designated military hospital within 5 days; medical certificates from other hospitals are not accepted and no further review/appeal is permissible.
  • Provisional Select List is prepared based on performance in Stage II written exam, subject to qualification in PFT and Recruitment Medical; merit list for SSR (Medical) is state-wise and cut-off for call-up to INS Chilka varies by state.
  • Pre-Enrolment Medical formalities are conducted at INS Chilka and induction is subject to qualifying these formalities; candidates not qualifying pre-enrolment medicals will be rejected.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online for Stage I – INET 2026 for SSR (MED) 02/2027 batch only through the website https://joinindiannavy.gov.in from 14 March 2026 (00:01 hrs) to 06 April 2026 (17:00 hrs).
  • Candidates must register and fill the online application with accurate personal, educational and contact details as per instructions on the portal.
  • All required original documents (certificates, mark sheets, domicile certificate, NCC certificate if held) must be scanned and uploaded as per the specifications given in the online application.
  • Candidates must upload the prescribed photograph as specified, and also capture a good quality live photograph through webcam during application.
  • Examination fee payment of Rs. 550/- plus 18% GST must be made online using net banking, credit/debit card or UPI during application; admit card will be generated only after successful fee payment.
  • Candidates may optionally use Common Service Centres (CSC) for uploading application for a service fee of Rs. 60 + GST.
  • After submission, candidates should regularly check their online dashboard on the recruitment website for updates, admit card download, results and call-up letters.
  • Candidates must download call-up letters cum admit cards for Stage I – INET and later stages from the website; no call-up letters will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must report to the examination centre as per reporting time mentioned in call-up letter; late reporting (30 minutes after reporting time) will not be permitted.
  • Selected candidates must carry all original documents and self-attested copies to recruitment stages including INS Chilka for verification; any discrepancy with online details will result in cancellation of candidature.

SSB Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver eligibility criteria include nationality, age limit, educational qualification, trade experience and medical/physical standards, and all conditions must be fulfilled as on the closing date of application.

Nationality

  • For Constables (Washerman, Barber, Water Carrier, Waiter, Tailor, Gardener, Cobbler): The candidate must be a citizen of India.

SSB Constable Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Recruitment 2026 are post-specific and must be from recognised boards/ITI/Institutes.

  • Constable (Veterinary): 10th pass with Science as main subject from a recognised board and 1 year experience in treatment of different species of animals in a recognised veterinary hospital.
  • Constable (Driver) – Male: 10th pass from a recognised board and must possess a valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence.
  • Constables (Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter): Matriculation or equivalent plus either 2 years work experience in the respective trade, or 1 year certificate course from recognised ITI/Vocational institute with at least 1 year experience, or 2 years diploma from recognised ITI in the trade or similar trade; must qualify trade test; multi-skilled candidates will be given preference.
  • Constable (Carpenter): Matriculation or equivalent and either 2 years work experience in the trade, or 1 year ITI/Vocational certificate with 1 year experience, or 2 years ITI diploma in the trade; must qualify trade test.
  • Constable (Nursing Orderly): 10th pass, First Aid certificate from St. John’s Ambulance Organisation or Red Cross Society of India, and minimum 1 year working experience as Nursing Orderly in a 50-bedded hospital/institution recognised by Central/State Government.

Candidates who are appearing in examination/awaiting results or not in possession of educational/professional certificates on the last date of application need not apply.

SSB Constable Selection Process 2026

The SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026 comprises multiple stages, and only those candidates who qualify each stage as per SSB norms will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): For Constables (Veterinary, Driver, Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter, Carpenter & Nursing Orderly), PET consists of 4.8 km race in 24 minutes for male candidates and 2.4 km race in 18 minutes for female candidates; Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must attend other stages.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will undergo PST where height and chest (for male candidates) are measured as per category and region-wise standards; those not meeting minimum standards are rejected.
  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern for Constable posts (detailed scheme to be provided on official website/notification).
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Driver post to assess hands-on skills.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards.

SSB Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The SSB Constable written exam pattern 2026 for Tradesman, Driver and other posts will generally include questions from General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning and Trade-related subjects as per SSB guidelines.

Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed exam scheme and syllabus published on the official SSB website and in the detailed recruitment notification before starting preparation.

All SSB Constable Tradesman, Driver, Veterinary, Carpenter and Nursing Orderly posts are placed in Pay Level-3 (₹21,700–69,100) of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

CSU Non-Teaching Posts Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

    • Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade.

    • Deputation: Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 5 years regular service in Level 7/Level 8 in Central/State Government, Universities or Autonomous Organizations; Knowledge of Computer Applications.

  • Section Officer (Level-7):
    • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute.
    • 3 years' experience as Assistant in Level-6 OR 8 years as UDC in Level-4 in Central/State Govt./University/PSU/Autonomous Institutions or equivalent in reputed private companies/banks with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
    • Proficiency in Computer Operation, noting and drafting.
    • Deputation: Officers holding analogous post on regular basis or with 3 years regular service in Level-6 or equivalent.
  • Nursing Officer (Level-7):
    • B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing / Regular B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognised University or Institute; Registered as a Nurse or Nurse and Midwife (RN or RN and RM) with State Nursing Council; 6 months' experience in minimum 50-bedded hospital after acquiring the qualification.
    • OR Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery from recognised Board or Council; Registered as RN or RN and RM with State Nursing Council; 2.5 years' experience in minimum 50-bedded hospital.
  • Assistant (Level-6):
    • Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University/Institution.
    • 3 years' experience as UDC or equivalent in Level-4 in Central/State Govt./University/PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent in reputed private companies/corporate banks with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 Crores.
    • Proficiency in Typing, Computer Applications, noting and drafting.
  • Guest House Manager (Level-6):
    • Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management or allied field with 1 year relevant experience; OR Diploma in Hotel Management or allied field with 2 years relevant experience.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Junior Engineer (Level-6):
    • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in relevant field with 1 year relevant experience; OR Diploma in Engineering in relevant field with 3 years' experience in CPWD/State PWD/Similar Organised Services/Statutory or Autonomous Organizations/Universities/reputed private construction companies with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Personal Assistant (Level-6):
    • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute.
    • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi at minimum 100 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Typing in English @ 35 wpm or Hindi @ 30 wpm.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
    • 2 years' experience as Stenographer or equivalent in Central/State Govt./University/Research Institution/Central/State Autonomous Institution/reputed private institutions with turnover of Rs. 200 Crores.
    • Desirable: Proficiency in English and good communication skills.
    • Skill Test: Dictation 10 minutes @ 100 wpm; Transcription: 40 minutes (English)/55 minutes (Hindi).
  • Professional Assistant (Level-6):
    • Master's Degree in Library & Information Science from recognised University/Institution with 2 years' experience in relevant field in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Institutions.
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Library/Library and Information Science with 3 years' experience in relevant field.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Technical Assistant – Shikshashastra/Education Lab. (Level-5):
    • Bachelor's Degree with minimum 3 years of working and maintenance/operation experience of Scientific Instruments in the Laboratory in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or Private Organization with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Technical Assistant – Computer Lab. (Level-5):
    • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Computer Science and Technology/Information Technology from any recognised University/Institute; OR Master's Degree in Computer Science/Technology/MCA.
    • At least 2 years' experience in relevant field in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or Private Organization with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Stenographer (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute.
    • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi at minimum 80 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Typing in English @ 35 wpm or Hindi @ 30 wpm.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
    • Skill Test: Dictation 10 minutes @ 80 wpm; Transcription: 50 minutes (English)/65 minutes (Hindi).
    • Desirable: Proficiency in English and good communication skills.
  • Upper Division Clerk – UDC (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree from any recognised University/Institute.
    • 2 years' experience as LDC/equivalent posts in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent in reputed private companies/corporate banks with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 Crores.
    • Speed in English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.
  • Library Assistant (Level-4):
    • Bachelor's Degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent from a recognised University.
    • Typing speed of 30 words per minute in English.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Lower Division Clerk – LDC (Level-2):
    • Bachelor's Degree from any recognised University/Institute.
    • English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm (35 wpm and 30 wpm correspond to 10500 KDPH/9000 KDPH on an average of 5 key depressions for each word).
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.
  • Driver (Level-2):
    • 10th Pass from any recognised Board.
    • Valid Commercial Driving License for Light/Medium/Heavy Vehicles issued by Competent Authority with no adverse endorsement.
    • Knowledge of motor mechanism (ability to remove minor defects in vehicles).
    • At least 5 years' driving experience in an organization.
  • Multi-Tasking Staff – MTS (Level-1):
    • 10th Pass from a recognised Board; OR ITI Pass.
  • Library Attendant (Level-1):
    • 10+2 or equivalent from a recognised Board.
    • Certificate Course in Library Science from a recognised Institution.
    • 1 year experience in a University/College/Educational Institution Library.
    • Basic knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Medical Attendant / Dresser (Level-1):
    • 10+2 or equivalent with Science from a recognised Board.
    • 1 year experience as Attendant in related field in any Government/recognised hospitals/diagnostics centres/accredited centres.
    • Knowledge of Computer.

Salary/Stipend

  • Registrar: Pay Level-14 – Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200 (as per 7th CPC)
  • Assistant Registrar & System Analyst: Pay Level-10 – Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500
  • Section Officer & Nursing Officer: Pay Level-07 – Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400
  • Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant: Pay Level-06 – Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400
  • Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab. & Computer Lab.): Pay Level-05 – Rs. 29,200 to Rs. 92,300
  • Stenographer, Upper Division Clerk & Library Assistant: Pay Level-04 – Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100
  • Lower Division Clerk & Driver: Pay Level-02 – Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200
  • Multi-Tasking Staff, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser: Pay Level-01 – Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900

Age Limit (as on 16.04.2026)

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years.
  • Assistant Registrar & System Analyst: Not exceeding 40 years.
  • Section Officer, Nursing Officer, Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant: Not exceeding 35 years.
  • Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra & Computer Lab.), Stenographer, UDC, Library Assistant, LDC, Driver, MTS, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser: Not exceeding 32 years.
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other eligible reserved categories.
  • Regular employees of Central/State Govt./Central Universities/UGC maintained Institutions/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies: Age relaxation as per Govt. of India rules.
  • Ex-Servicemen: Upper age limit for Group 'C' posts is relaxable up to 40 years (General) and 45 years (SC/ST) for candidates who have rendered 3 years continuous regular service.
  • Deputation candidates for posts below Pay Level-14: Must be less than 56 years of age; for Pay Level-14 and above: less than 58 years of age.

Application Fee

Pay Level Posts General / OBC / EWS SC / ST / PwBD
Level-10 to Level-14 Registrar, Assistant Registrar & System Analyst Rs. 3,000/- Rs. 1,500/-
Level-6 to Level-9 Section Officer, Nursing Officer, Assistant, Guest House Manager, Junior Engineer, Personal Assistant & Professional Assistant Rs. 2,000/- Rs. 1,000/-
Level-1 to Level-5 Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab.), Technical Assistant (Computer Lab.), Stenographer, UDC, Library Assistant, LDC, Driver, MTS, Library Attendant & Medical Attendant/Dresser Rs. 1,000/- (including Ex-Servicemen) Rs. 500/-
  • Fee payment mode: Online only through the SAMARTH portal link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Separate fee is required for each post applied for.
  • Applications submitted without requisite fee shall be rejected.
  • Any other mode of payment except online shall not be accepted.

Selection Process

  • Most posts will be filled through Direct Recruitment; certain posts through Deputation or Direct Recruitment failing which by Deputation.
  • Eligible candidates will undergo a Written Test (OMR Based / Descriptive) in the first instance.
  • Candidates shortlisted through Written Test will be called for Skill Test and/or Interview (as applicable to the post).
  • Examination Centres: Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata & Bengaluru (candidate may choose one city).
  • Examination Schedules (to avoid conflicts):
    • Schedule 1: System Analyst, Junior Engineer, Assistant, Technical Assistant (Shikshashastra/Education Lab.), Driver.
    • Schedule 2: Section Officer, Technical Assistant (Computer Lab.), Personal Assistant, Professional Assistant, Multi-Tasking Staff.
    • Schedule 3: Assistant Registrar, Upper Division Clerk, Library Assistant, Stenographer, Medical Attendant/Dresser, Library Attendant.
    • Schedule 4: Nursing Officer, Guest House Manager, Lower Division Clerk.
  • Candidates applying for multiple posts within the same Schedule cannot appear for both simultaneously.
  • For Registrar post: Direct/Deputation for tenure of 5 years or till superannuation (62 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Detailed Scheme of Examination and Syllabus available at: https://www.sanskrit.nic.in/scheme_of_exam.php

General Information / Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted Online through the SAMARTH Link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/ available on the University's website www.sanskrit.nic.in under "Recruitment/Notification".
  • After online submission, candidates must send a duly signed hard copy of the application along with self-attested copies of all supporting documents through Registered Post within 15 days from the last date of online application.
  • Hard copy for Registrar post to be sent to: The Vice Chancellor, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • Hard copy for all other posts to be sent to: The Registrar, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • Mere possession of eligibility conditions does not entitle a candidate to be called for written/skill tests.
  • Candidates must apply separately for each post with separate requisite fee.
  • The University posts belong to All-India Cadre — once appointed, transfer requests will not be considered for a minimum lock-in period of 10 years.
  • Candidates currently in service (State/Central Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer at the time of document verification/interview.
  • PwBD candidates with less than 40% benchmark disability must submit a valid Disability Certificate uploaded with the application.
  • OBC NCL certificate must be issued on or after 01.04.2025 to be considered valid for this advertisement.
  • EWS certificate (current financial year) must be valid on or before the last date of online application submission.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid technical issues.
  • All future updates/notices will be published only on www.sanskrit.nic.in — candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • For technical support during online application: [email protected]
  • In case of any dispute, jurisdiction shall be Hon'ble Courts in Delhi.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official CSU website: www.sanskrit.nic.in under the "Recruitment/Notification" section.
  • Register and apply online through the SAMARTH Link: https://sanskritnt.samarth.edu.in/
  • Upload clear, high-quality scanned copies of all requisite documents during online application.
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online only through the payment link in the application portal.
  • After successful online submission, print a signed hard copy of the application form.
  • Send the signed hard copy along with self-attested copies of all supporting documents through Registered Post within 15 days from the last date of online application (16/04/2026) to the appropriate address:
    • For Registrar Post: The Vice Chancellor, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
    • For all other posts: The Registrar, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
  • The last date for online application is 16 April 2026 by 11:30 PM (IST).
  • Candidates must complete both steps (online submission + hard copy submission) within the prescribed timelines; failure to comply with either may lead to rejection.

Event Date

Date of Examination To be intimated in due course through the website of the Board

Selection Process

  • The selection shall be made through examination schemes as specified below:
    • One Tier (General) – Post Code 17/26: One Tier exam (I-T-G) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Syllabus: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (40 marks each). Final merit will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the written examination.
    • One Tier (Technical) – Post Codes 07/26, 08/26, 09/26, 10/26, 11/26, 13/26, 14/26, 16/26, 18/26, 19/26, 20/26: One Tier exam (I-T-T) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Section-A: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (20 marks each; 100 questions: 100 marks). Section-B: Objective type MCQs on the subject concerned as per the qualification prescribed for the post (100 questions: 100 marks). Mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable only in domain subject specific Section-B, not in Section-A. Combined marks of both sections reckoned for final merit list.
    • Two Tier (General) – Post Code 12/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-G). Tier-I (2 hours): 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks) + Part-II Descriptive (75 marks) = Grand Total 275. Part-II: Essay in English (50 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (25 marks). Selection based on cumulative marks obtained in Part-I & Part-II of Tier-II.
    • Two Tier (Technical-2) – Post Codes 01/26, 02/26, 03/26, 04/26, 05/26, 06/26, 15/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-T2). Tier-I (2 hours): Section-A (100 questions: 100 marks, general) + Section-B (100 questions: 100 marks, subject-related) = 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks, subject-related) + Part-II Descriptive (50 marks) = Grand Total 250. Part-II: Essay in English (30 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (20 marks). In Tier-II, mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable in domain subject specific Part-I; combined marks of both parts reckoned for final merit list.
  • Marks scored by candidates in the Computer Based Test/Exam will be normalized (if required) using the formula published by DSSSB vide Notice No. 10(271)/Sec.Cell/DSSSB/18/989 dated 11.07.2018.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS: 40%; OBC (Delhi): 35%; SC/ST/PH (PwBD): 30%. Ex-Servicemen will be given 5% relaxation in their respective categories, subject to a minimum of 30%.
  • Negative Marking: Deduction of 0.25 marks for each wrong MCQ answer of 01 mark.
  • Skill Test / Physical Endurance Test / Driving Test / Trade Test etc. will be taken as per requirement of the job.
  • Draft answer keys of the Computer Based Examination will be displayed on the DSSSB website after the examination. Candidates may submit online objections within the stipulated time limit.

How to Apply

  • Before submitting online applications, the candidate must ensure that he/she is registered on DSSSB's portal i.e. https://dsssbonline.nic.in. Registration with DSSSB is a one-time exercise.
  • Eligible candidates may apply online through the website https://dsssbonline.nic.in from 27th February 2026 (12.00 Noon) up to 28th March 2026 (till 11:59 PM), thereafter the link will be disabled.
  • Candidates must go through the instructions carefully while filling up the online application form for the post concerned.
  • Candidates must submit their application through Online Mode only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode i.e. by post / by hand / by mail etc. will not be accepted.
  • Pay the application fee of ₹100/- through SBI e-Pay only. No other mode of payment shall be accepted.
  • Before submission of the online application, candidates must check and ensure that they have filled correct details. Once the online application form is submitted, no request for change/correction/modification (including change of category) shall be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • If an applicant submits multiple registrations and appears in the examination more than once, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will be debarred from the examinations of the Board.
  • Candidates are advised to upload a recent and clear colour photograph. The background should be plain white or off-white, with full face, front view, eyes open.
  • Candidates must fill their correct and active e-mail addresses and mobile numbers in the online application form.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take a printout of the online application form for their own records.

Eligibility criteria - IIT Delhi Non Academic Recruitment 2026

1) Nationality & general eligibility

  • Applicants must be Indian Nationals and meet all conditions specified in Advt. No. E‑II/01/2026(DR) and E‑II/02/2026(DR) for IIT Delhi Non Academic posts.

  • Age limits and relaxations are as per point 13 of Appendix A1 of the Recruitment and Promotion Rules (Amendments) 2022 for Non‑Academic Staff of IIT Delhi; cut‑off date for age, experience and qualification is 08 April 2026.

2) Educational qualification & experience (brief)

  • Superintending Engineer: Master’s/Bachelor’s in relevant Engineering with long Group‑A experience as Executive Engineer in specified pay levels.​

  • Chief Security Officer: Commissioned Officer/Police officer with Bachelor’s/Master’s degree and 15–20 years relevant experience as per clauses.​

  • Medical Officer & Medical Officer (Psychiatry): MBBS with compulsory internship and minimum 3 years’ experience in recognised hospital; PG degree/diploma preferred.​

  • Career Counsellor: Master’s in Psychology/Social Work/relevant discipline with at least 7 years’ experience in psychometric testing and career counselling.​

  • AEE (Civil), JE (Electrical), Application Analyst, Assistant Administrative Officer, Administrative Assistant, Accounts & Audit Assistant: specified degree/diploma (Civil/Electrical/Computer/Commerce/Any discipline) with required experience and minimum 55% marks.​

3) Age limits (post-wise upper age)

  • Superintending Engineer: 55 years; Chief Security Officer: 50 years.​

  • Medical Officer / Medical Officer (Psychiatry) / Career Counsellor: 45 years.​

  • AEE (Civil): 45 years; JE (Electrical), Application Analyst, Assistant Administrative Officer: 35 years.​

  • Administrative Assistant, Accounts & Audit Assistant: 30 years.​

4) Reservation & PwBD

  • E‑II/01/2026 is a Special Recruitment Drive to fill 6 backlog PwBD vacancies in specified posts with detailed functional requirements and categories of disabilities.​

  • E‑II/02/2026 posts are UR but identified as suitable for certain PwBD categories; age relaxation and other benefits for SC/ST/OBC‑NCL/EWS/PwBD/Ex‑servicemen as per Government of India norms.

IIT Delhi Non Academic Application Fees 2026

Candidates applying for IIT Delhi Non Academic Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. E-II/01/2026(DR) and E-II/02/2026(DR)) have to pay the combined application plus processing fee as per their category. The IIT Delhi non teaching application fee details are given below.

Category IIT Delhi Application Fee 2026
UR / EWS / OBC ₹1500
SC / ST / PwBD / Women / Ex-Servicemen ₹750 (processing fee only; exempt from application fee)

The IIT Delhi non academic application fee must be paid online through the NIELIT portal while submitting the application form and is non-refundable under any circumstances.

Selection Process

  • Screening/shortlisting of applications based on eligibility, qualifications and experience; higher criteria may be applied if applications are large in number.
  • Tier-wise selection stages (Tier-I, Tier-II, Tier-III such as written test, presentation and interview for Group A posts) followed by document verification; ratio of 1:8 candidates per vacancy for higher tiers in Group A posts.
  • Final merit list prepared based on performance in selection stages; appointment subject to verification of original documents and fulfilment of all conditions.

How to Apply for IIT Delhi Non Academic Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the NIELIT portal at https://recruit-iitd.nielit.in/ and open the IIT Delhi Non Academic recruitment page for Advt. No. E-II/01/2026(DR) or E-II/02/2026(DR).
  2. Read the detailed IIT Delhi Non Academic notification 2026 and check post-wise eligibility, age limit, experience and PwBD reservations carefully.
  3. Register with a valid email ID and mobile number, then fill the online application form with personal details, educational qualifications, and complete employment history in reverse chronological order.
  4. Upload scanned copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, pay-scale proof, caste/EWS/PwBD certificates, ID proof and other documents in the prescribed format.
  5. Pay the required fee online – ₹1500 for UR/EWS/OBC and ₹750 for SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Ex-Servicemen (processing fee only, application fee exempt for these categories). The fee once paid is non-refundable.
  6. Submit the IIT Delhi Non Academic application form and download/print the confirmation page and fee receipt for future reference and document verification.
