FSSAI Internship 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Students must be pursuing a full-time Graduate, Post Graduate or higher degree from a recognised institute in India or abroad in specified disciplines to be eligible for FSSAI Internship 2026.

  • Food & Technical Streams: PG Degree / B.Tech / BE in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Food Technology, Food Science & Technology, Food & Nutrition, Edible Oil Technology, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, Agricultural / Horticultural Sciences, Industrial Microbiology, Toxicology, Public Health, Life Science, Biotechnology, Fruit & Vegetable Technology, Food Safety & Quality Assurance.
  • Management & Related Fields: Business Administration & Management including Policy, Finance, Taxation, Marketing, HR, Economics, Statistics, ICT, Entrepreneurship and related areas.
  • Media & Communication: PG Diploma / Degree in Journalism, Mass Communication and Public Relations.
  • IT & Computer Science: B.E. / B.Tech (only 3rd & 4th year) in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or related streams.
  • Other Disciplines: PG Degree / Diploma in Public Policy / Public Administration (for FSSAI HQ only), Bachelor / Master of Law, Bachelor of Commerce & equivalent courses.

Students who have already completed the above courses are not eligible to apply for the FSSAI Internship April–June 2026.

FSSAI Internship 2026 Stipend

Under the FSSAI Internship April–June 2026, selected deserving interns will be paid a consolidated stipend for the entire internship period. The stipend is released on the recommendation of the concerned office/division based on attendance and performance.

Particulars FSSAI Internship 2026 Stipend
Stipend Amount ₹10,000 (for the whole internship period)
Payment Basis Only to deserving interns based on attendance, reporting officer’s assessment and evaluation of final report
Paid By Concerned Office/Division where intern is attached

All deserving interns who successfully complete the FSSAI Internship 2026 and submit their final report/presentation are also awarded an official internship certificate by FSSAI.

FSSAI Internship 2026 Application Form

The FSSAI Internship 2026 application form for the April–June quarter is available only in online mode on the official FSSAI internship portal. Eligible students pursuing the required degree programmes have to fill and submit the FSSAI Internship April–June 2026 online form within the specified dates.

Candidates can access the FSSAI Internship application form 2026 by visiting the official website fssai.gov.in and navigating to the Internship section or directly opening the internship portal link. In the application form, students must provide their personal details, academic information, ongoing course, institute details, preferred location/area of internship and upload the required documents as per the instructions given in the notification.

After filling all details correctly, applicants should review the entries and submit the FSSAI Internship 2026 online application before the last date i.e. 27 March 2026. The list of shortlisted candidates along with date of joining and internship tenure will be published later on the official FSSAI website.

FSSAI Internship 2026 Selection Process

The FSSAI Internship 2026 selection process is merit-based and carried out through online scrutiny of applications by the concerned Nodal Officers at FSSAI (HQ), Regional Offices and National Food Laboratories.

  • Online Application: Interested and eligible students must submit the FSSAI Internship application form in the prescribed online format within the given timeline.
  • Short Write-up / Presentation: Candidates may be required to submit a short write-up or presentation on a relevant topic in the application portal as part of the selection process.
  • Scrutiny by Nodal Officers: All applications are scrutinized by Nodal Officers of the respective divisions/locations based on eligibility, academic background and suitability for available domains.
  • Publication of Shortlisted List: The final list of selected candidates, along with their date of joining and internship tenure, is published on the FSSAI website at fssai.gov.in/[email protected].
  • Document Verification at Joining: At the time of joining, selected interns must produce a letter from their institute, No Objection Certificate (NOC), character certificate and proof of educational qualifications as mentioned in the application.

How to Apply for FSSAI Internship 2026

Eligible students can apply online for the FSSAI Internship April–June 2026 only through the official FSSAI internship portal within the prescribed dates. Follow the steps below to submit your FSSAI Internship 2026 application form.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of FSSAI – fssai.gov.in and open the Internship section or directly go to fssai.gov.in/[email protected].
  • Step 2: Read the latest FSSAI Internship Scheme 2024 notification for the April–June 2026 quarter, including eligibility, duration, locations and important dates.
  • Step 3: Click on the “Apply Online” link for FSSAI Internship and register using a valid email ID and mobile number, if registration is required on the portal.
  • Step 4: Fill in the FSSAI Internship application form 2026 with your personal details, academic information, ongoing course, institute details and preferred location/area of internship.
  • Step 5: Upload the required documents and, if asked, submit a short write-up or presentation in the application portal as per the instructions given in the notification.
  • Step 6: Carefully review all the details entered in the online form and submit the application before the last date i.e. 27 March 2026.
  • Step 7: Save and take a printout/PDF of the submitted FSSAI Internship 2026 online application for future reference; the list of shortlisted candidates will be published later on the FSSAI website.

Medical Officers Grade – General Duty (CHS) 34 OA, OL, BL, OAL, CP, LC, DW, AAV: 17 | SLD + MD involving above: 17

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Candidate must be a Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal, or a subject of Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries. Candidates under categories (b) to (e) require an eligibility certificate from Government of India.
  • Qualification: Candidate must have passed the written and practical parts of the final MBBS Examination from a recognized university.
  • Provisional Admission: A candidate who has appeared or is yet to appear in the final MBBS Examination may also apply. Such admission will be provisional and subject to cancellation if proof of passing is not produced within the stipulated time period after result declaration of the written examination (within 15 days window provided by the Commission).
  • Internship: A candidate who has yet to complete the compulsory rotating internship is educationally eligible to appear in the examination, but will be appointed only after completion of the compulsory rotating internship.
  • Physical & Medical Standards: Candidates must be physically and medically fit according to the physical/medical standards for CMS Examination 2026 as per regulations contained in Appendix III to the Rules of the Examination.
  • Marital Status: No person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a living spouse, or having a living spouse has entered into a marriage with any other person, shall be eligible, unless exempted under personal law applicable and with Central Government approval.

Salary / Stipend

  • Assistant Divisional Medical Officer (Railways): Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) + Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) as per rules. Private practice is prohibited.
  • Medical Officers Grade – Central Health Service (CHS): Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) + NPA as per orders issued by Government from time to time. Private practice of any kind, including Lab and consultant practice, is prohibited.
  • General Duty Medical Officer – NDMC: Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 – 1,77,500) + Restricted NPA. Promotion to Senior Medical Officer (Level-11: Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700), Chief Medical Officer (Level-12: Rs. 78,800 – 2,09,200), Chief Medical Officer (NFSG) (Level-13: Rs. 1,18,500 – 2,14,100), and Senior Administrative Grade (Level-14: Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200).
  • General Duty Medical Officer Grade-II – MCD: Minimum of first cell Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 of Pay Matrix under 7th CPC + NPA and other admissible allowances. Private practice of any kind is prohibited.
  • All appointed candidates will be governed by the Contributory Pension System (NPS) effective from 01.01.2004 (for Railways) as per Government orders.

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2026)

  • Maximum Age (General): 32 Years (candidate must have been born not earlier than 2nd August 1994)
  • For Medical Officers Grade – General Duty (CHS): Maximum 35 Years as on 01.08.2026
  • SC / ST candidates: Upper age relaxable by maximum 5 years
  • OBC candidates: Upper age relaxable by maximum 3 years
  • Defence Services personnel disabled in operations: Maximum 3 years relaxation
  • Ex-Servicemen (with at least 5 years Military Service as on 01.08.2026): Maximum 5 years relaxation
  • ECOs/SSCOs (with initial assignment of 5 years Military Service extended beyond 5 years): Maximum 5 years relaxation (with Ministry of Defence certificate)
  • Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD): Maximum 10 years relaxation
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC who also fall under Ex-Servicemen or PwBD categories are eligible for cumulative age relaxation under both categories.
  • Date of Birth accepted: as entered in the Matriculation / Secondary School Leaving Certificate or equivalent recognized certificate only. No other document for age proof will be accepted.

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS Candidates: Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred only)
  • Exempted from Fee: All Female candidates, SC candidates, ST candidates, and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates
  • Note: OBC and EWS candidates are NOT exempted and must pay the full fee of Rs. 200/-.
  • Mode of Payment: Net Banking of any Bank, or Visa/Master/RuPay/Credit/Debit Card/UPI Payment only.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination.
  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee (unless fee remission is claimed) shall be summarily rejected.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Date of Notification of Examination 11/03/2026
Opening of Online Application 11/03/2026
Last Date for Filling Up of Online Application 31/03/2026 (up to 06:00 PM)
Date of Written Examination 02/08/2026
Helpline Operational Period 11.03.2026 to 31.03.2026 (10:00 AM to 5:30 PM on working days)
Issuance of e-Admit Card Last working day of the preceding week of the date of examination
Representation Window on Question Paper / Provisional Answer Keys 3rd day to 7th day (06:00 PM) after the Examination date

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on two stages: Written Examination (500 Marks) + Personality Test/Interview (100 Marks) = Total 600 Marks.
  • Written Examination (Part-I) – 500 Marks:
    • Paper-I (Code No. 1): General Medicine and Paediatrics – 250 Marks | 120 Questions (96 from General Medicine + 24 from Paediatrics) | Duration: 2 hours
    • Paper-II (Code No. 2): Surgery, Gynaecology & Obstetrics, Preventive & Social Medicine – 250 Marks | 120 Questions (40 from each part) | Duration: 2 hours
    • Both papers are completely Objective Type (Multiple Choice Answers). Question papers are in English only.
    • Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) of marks assigned to that question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty for unanswered questions.
  • Personality Test/Interview (Part-II) – 100 Marks: Candidates qualifying the written examination will be called for Interview/Personality Test conducted by the Commission to assess General Knowledge, academic ability, intellectual curiosity, balance of judgment, integrity of character, initiative and leadership.
  • Tie-Breaking Principle:
    • If Final Marks are equal: candidate securing more marks in Written Total ranked higher.
    • If still equal: senior in age ranked higher.
    • If Date of Birth also same: candidate whose date of completion of Internship is earlier ranked higher.
    • If tie persists: resolved at the discretion of the Commission.
  • The Commission has discretion to fix qualifying marks in any or both papers of the examination.
  • Successful candidates will be considered for appointment on the basis of order of merit and preferences expressed for various posts.
  • Exam Centres: 48 centres across India including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Aizawl, Bareilly, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Chennai, Cuttack, Dehradun, Delhi, Dharwad, Dispur, Faridabad, Gangtok, Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida), Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Imphal, Itanagar, Jaipur, Jammu, Jorhat, Kanpur, Kochi, Kohima, Kolkata, Lucknow, Madurai, Meerut, Mumbai, Nagpur, Panaji (Goa), Patna, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Prayagraj (Allahabad), Raipur, Ranchi, Sambalpur, Shillong, Shimla, Srinagar, Thiruvananthapuram, Tirupati, Udaipur, Visakhapatnam.
  • Allotment of Centres is on "first-apply-first-allot" basis. PwBD candidates can opt for their desired centre regardless of ceiling.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue.
  • Candidates must reach the examination venue at least 30 minutes prior to commencement of each session. No late entry will be allowed.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only at: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • Complete the following four modules on the portal:
    • Account Creation
    • Universal Registration (URN Profile) – register once in lifetime
    • Common Application Form (CAF)
    • Examination Specific Module (including fee payment and centre selection)
  • Upload: scanned photograph (.jpg, 20 KB to 200 KB), scanned signature (.jpg, 20 KB to 100 KB), and a live photograph during CAF filling.
  • Signature must be signed three times (one below the other) on plain white paper in black ink.
  • Keep one Photo ID (Aadhaar Card / Voter Card / PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Any other State/Central Govt. issued Photo ID) for all future references.
  • Pay the prescribed fee of Rs. 200/- online through Net Banking / Visa / Master / RuPay / Credit / Debit Card / UPI (not applicable for exempted candidates).
  • Application window: 11.03.2026 to 31.03.2026 (06:00 PM).
  • Candidates are strongly advised to apply well in advance to secure their preferred examination centre (first-apply-first-allot basis).
  • Candidates in Government service must submit an undertaking to their Head of Office/Department and mention it in the application.
  • Do not submit multiple applications. Multiple applications by the same candidate will be rejected.
  • Hard copy of the application form is NOT required to be submitted to the Commission.
  • Candidates qualified for Personality Test must mandatorily login to the portal within 15 days of result declaration of written examination to update details and upload proof of passing the qualifying examination.

Selection Process

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

General Information / Instructions

  • Posts are temporary but likely to continue. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or outside the Territory of India and will be governed by SSB Act & Rules and other Rules amended from time to time.
  • A candidate can apply for only one post from amongst the posts mentioned in the notification.
  • Applications received through any mode except Online Mode shall not be accepted and rejected straightway.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who fulfill eligibility criteria of unreserved category may apply against the unreserved category for posts where no vacancies are reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS.

  • Biometrics of both thumbs (Left & Right) of candidates will be taken for verification in all stages after attendance.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings should apply through proper channel and submit NOC from their employer at the time of documentation.
  • Name, Father's Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in the Matriculation certificate.
  • Candidates should be prepared for a stay of at least one week at the recruitment venue at their own arrangement. No TA/DA will be admissible.
  • Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in the written test will be reimbursed fare as admissible under relevant Rules subject to production of Rail/Bus tickets, original caste certificate and Non-employment certificate issued by MP or MLA or any Gazetted Officer.
  • Persons with bigamy/marriage to a person with a living spouse are disqualified. Conviction by court of law or dismissal from Government service also leads to disqualification.
  • Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.
  • The DG, SSB has full right to make changes/cancel/postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • There will be no provision of reserve merit list/panel. If vacancies remain unfilled after declaration of final result, the same will be carried forward for the next recruitment.
  • Any amendment in the schedule/condition/process of recruitment will be available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ only.

CSBC Bihar Police Constable (Operator) Eligibility Criteria

Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen.

Physical Standards

  • Height:

    • Extremely Backward Class Males: 160 cm
    • SC/ST Males: 160 cm
    • All Females: 155 cm
  • Chest (Males only):

Selection in three stages:

  1. Written Exam:

    • Syllabus: Intermediate level (Bihar Board).
    • Sections: 25 Qs General Knowledge/Current Affairs; 25 each Physics, Chemistry, Math.
    • Minimum 30% to qualify for PET.
    • Shortlist up to 5 times vacancies category-wise (may reduce if insufficient candidates).
    • Normalization for multi-shift exams.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) (Qualifying):
    • Running: 1.6 km in 6 min (males); 1 km in 6 min (females).
    • High Jump: 3 ft 6 in (males); 2 ft 6 in (females).
    • Shot Put: 16 lb to 15 ft (males); 12 lb to 8 ft (females).
    • Up to 3 attempts per event.
    • Physical measurements checked; failure disqualifies.
    • No marks; must pass all events.
  3. Document Verification:
    • Verify education, age, reservation certificates.
    • Originals required; failure leads to disqualification.

Final merit based on written exam marks (tie-breakers: age, higher qualification, alphabetical name order).

Medical exam and character verification before appointment.

SECL Apprentice Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for SECL Apprenticeship 2026 are stream-specific and must be from Government-recognised institutions in full-time regular mode only.

50% stipend paid by SECL and 50% by Government through DBT in Aadhaar-linked bank account.

Advertisement
Company Name Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
Post Name Junior Research Fellowships
No of Posts 105 (Indicative)
Advt No 4/2026(R-V)
Salary ₹37,000/- per month for first two years (JRF), ₹42,000/- per month from third year onwards (SRF), with contingency grant including book allowance of ₹60,000/- per year
Qualification M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Physics, Chemistry or Life Sciences with required subject combinations and aggregate marks, along with valid national level examination as specified
Age Limit Less than 28 years as on 01-08-2026 (relaxation: OBC-NCL 3 years, SC/ST 5 years, PwBD 10 years)
Start Date for Apply  10/03/2026
Last Date for Apply  31/03/2026
Official Website https://www.barc.gov.in

BARC Junior Research Fellowships Vacancy 2026 Details 

Post Name No. of Fellowships
Junior Research Fellowships 105 (Indicative)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates must be Indian nationals with consistently good academic record.
  • Only those who have successfully cleared and possess valid certificate for at least one of the following national level examinations are eligible: UGC-CSIR-NET Fellowship (SLET/Lectureship not eligible), JEST, ICMR-JRF Test, ICAR-JRF Test, DBT-JRF Biotechnology Eligibility Test, GATE in Physics/Chemistry/Life Sciences/Biotechnology, or JGEEBILS.
  • Candidates should have secured minimum 60% aggregate in B.Sc. and 55% aggregate in M.Sc. from a recognized University.
  • Candidates with five years Integrated M.Sc./B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) should have secured minimum 55% aggregate.
  • Candidates having a 4-year / 8-semester bachelor’s degree (B.S with fourth year Research) with minimum 75% marks in aggregate are also eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed but are awaiting final results of M.Sc., Integrated M.Sc., B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) or B.S. (with fourth year Research) may also apply, subject to specified minimum aggregates up to the previous semester and completion of degree requirements before 10-08-2026.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Physics with Mathematics as one of the subjects at B.Sc. level is eligible.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Chemistry (General/Applied/Organic/Inorganic/Physical/Analytical) with Physics as ancillary subject at B.Sc. level and Mathematics at H.Sc. level is eligible, subject to passing marks in these subjects.
  • M.Sc. / Integrated M.Sc. / B.S-M.S. (Dual degree) / B.S. (with fourth year Research) in Life Sciences disciplines (including Life Science, Botany, Zoology, Agriculture, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Marine Biology, Bioinformatics, Genetics, Plant Science, Plant Breeding, Plant Pathology, Entomology, Animal Science, Biomedical Sciences, Biosciences, Food Science, Food Science and Technology) with Physics or Chemistry or Biochemistry or Agriculture Chemistry or allied Chemistry as one of the subjects at B.Sc./five-year integrated M.Sc. level is eligible.
  • Candidates with specializations listed as not eligible in Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (such as Electronics and Instrumentation, Industrial Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Textile Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Petroleum Chemistry, Nanoscience, Nanotechnology, Fisheries, Horticulture, Forestry, Agronomy, Animal Husbandry, Bio-analytical Sciences, Polymer Science, Medicine/Medical Science, Pharmaceutical Science, Home Science, and B.Tech./M.Tech. in Life Sciences disciplines) are not eligible.
  • All academic requirements for the qualifying degree must be completed before 10-08-2026, and relevant proof must be produced at joining.

Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will initially be considered as Junior Research Fellows (JRF) and will be paid a stipend of ₹37,000/- per month for a period of two years.
  • On satisfactory performance and review, the fellowship will be upgraded to Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) from the third year onwards with a stipend of ₹42,000/- per month (consolidated).
  • The total duration of the fellowship is five years.
  • Candidates are entitled to a contingency grant including book allowance of ₹60,000/- per year.
  • Financial assistance to attend one International Conference abroad during the PhD Programme may be provided, subject to conditions updated by HBNI.

Age Limit 

  • The candidate should be less than 28 years of age as on 01-08-2026.
  • Age relaxation is applicable up to 3 years for Other Backward Class Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL) applicants.
  • Age relaxation is applicable up to 5 years for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe applicants.
  • Additional 10 years of age relaxation is applicable for persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) applicants.
  • Age, qualification, community status and creamy layer status will be reckoned as on 01-08-2026 for submission of online application.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹500/- is payable at the time of submission of online application.
  • Mode of payment of the application fee is online only, using net banking, debit card, credit card, UPI, etc.
  • Application fee is exempted for Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Person with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • After submission of the online application, the applicant has to make online payment of application fee using the Application Number generated; applications without fee payment will be treated as incomplete and rejected.
  • Candidates must use the ‘Make Payment’ option under the ‘My Account’ menu to pay the fee, selecting the generated application number from the drop-down list.
  • Detailed guidelines for payment of application fee are available under the menu “How to pay Application fee.”
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances and cannot be held in reserve for any other recruitment.
  • Application fee should be paid on or before the last date of receipt of online application.

Important Dates

Event Date
Receipt of applications (Start date) 10/03/2026
Receipt of applications (Last date) 31/03/2026
Interview (tentative dates) June-July 2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized and candidates will be screened in for interview based on eligibility as per the national level exam and their score in the qualifying exam.
  • The number of candidates to be called for interview will be decided by the Selection Committee.
  • Final selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the selection interview only.
  • Allotment of research project will be on the basis of performance in the selection interview; in case of a tie, marks obtained in M.Sc./B.Sc. will be considered.
  • The recommendation/decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Facility for submission of online application will be available from 10/03/2026 to 31/03/2026 at the specified application portal.
  • Applications will be accepted online only and candidates should not submit multiple applications.
  • Candidates must read the instructions in the advertisement and online application form carefully before making any entry or selecting any option, and keep necessary documents/certificates ready.
  • All Educational and Professional Qualifications must be indicated under the ‘Educational & Professional Qualifications’ column; otherwise, the application will not be processed.
  • Candidates “pursuing” relevant degrees must choose the correct option from the ‘Name of Examination’ drop-down box, while those who have completed the degree must choose the appropriate completed option.
  • A valid e-mail ID and mobile number are mandatory, and the email ID must remain active till declaration of results; call letters or instructions may be sent by email or made available on the website.
  • Photo and signature must be clearly visible in preview; a recent front-facing passport size photograph in JPEG format of size not exceeding 50 KB must be uploaded, otherwise the application will be rejected.
  • Candidates must upload SSC/H.Sc./B.Sc./M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc./B.S-M.S. (Dual degree)/B.S. (with fourth year Research) mark sheets and Degree Certificates, valid Qualifying Examination Score Card and Caste Certificate (if applicable); applications without these attachments will be disqualified.
  • Before final submission, candidates should verify that all details, including name and date of birth, are correct as per SSC; no change or correction will be allowed after final submission.
  • If original educational documents have been submitted to another institution, copies may be uploaded and a letter from the Head of that institution must be produced at the time of interview.
  • In case of any difficulty in applying online or uploading documents, candidates should email complaints with screenshots to the specified email address given in the notification.

Eligibility criteria - South Central Railway Act Apprentice 2025-26

1) Educational qualification​

  • 10th class/SSC passed under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board.

  • ITI certificate in the relevant notified trade from an institute recognised by NCVT/SCVT (trade-wise: AC Mechanic, Carpenter, COPA, Diesel Mechanic, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, Industrial Electronics, Machinist, MMTM, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Painter, Welder).

  • Candidate must possess required qualification as on date of online application submission.

  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible for this Act Apprentice notification (covered under separate scheme).

2) Age limit (as on 11.04.2026)​

  • Minimum age: 15 years.

  • Maximum age: 24 years.

Category-wise permissible date of birth range:

Category Date of birth between
UR / EWS 11-04-2002 and 11-04-2011
SC / ST 11-04-1997 and 11-04-2011
OBC-NCL 11-04-1999 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (UR) 11-04-1992 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (SC/ST) 11-04-1987 and 11-04-2011
Ex-Servicemen / PwBD (OBC) 11-04-1989 and 11-04-2011

Relaxations included in above ranges:

  • SC/ST: +5 years.

  • OBC-NCL: +3 years.

  • PwBD: +10 years.

  • Ex-Servicemen: +10 years up to length of service in Defence Forces (no extra relaxation for their children).

3) Residential / jurisdiction eligibility​
Candidates must reside in districts under South Central Railway jurisdiction and provide valid proof of residence. Eligible areas:

  • Telangana: all districts.

  • Andhra Pradesh: all districts except Manyam, Srikakulam, Vizianagaram.

  • Maharashtra: Akola, Amaravati, Aurangabad, Beed, Chandrapur, Hingoli, Jalna, Latur, Nanded, Nasik, Parbhani, Washim, Yavatmal.

  • Karnataka: Balki, Bellari, Belgaum, Bidar, Gulbarga/Kalaburgi, Raichur, Yadgir.

  • Tamil Nadu: Vellore.

  • Madhya Pradesh: Burhanpur, Khandwa.

4) Category certificates (for reservation)​

  • SC/ST: Central Government format caste certificate (Annexure-B).

  • OBC-NCL: caste + NCL certificate (issued within 3 years) in Central format (Annexure-C) + self-declaration (Annexure-D).

  • EWS: valid Income & Asset certificate (Annexure-E).

  • PwBD: disability ≥40% in prescribed format (Annexure-G/H).

5) Salary/Stipend

  • Selected candidates will be paid a stipend during the apprenticeship at the prescribed rates as per extant instructions.

SCR Apprentice Selection Process 2025-26

  • Merit List Basis: Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both.
  • No Exam / Interview: There will be no written test or viva-voce for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26.
  • Tie-breaking: If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified.
  • Medical Fitness: Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered.
  • Training & Stipend: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training.
  • No Job Guarantee: SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there is no guarantee of regular railway job after completion of apprenticeship.

South Central Railway Apprentice Application Form 2026

  • Application Mode: Online only via RRC/SCR portal; no offline forms will be accepted.
  • Application Dates: SCR Apprentice online form 2026 is available from 12 March 2026 (17:00 hrs) to 11 April 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Fee: ₹100 for applicable categories; SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.
  • Multiple Trades: Candidates with ITI in more than one trade can submit separate SCR Apprentice application 2026 for each trade.
  • Communication: All updates regarding SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 application form, merit list and DV will be sent via registered email/SMS and uploaded on RRC-SCR webpage only.

How to Apply for South Central Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2025-26

  1. Visit the official South Central Railway website: https://scr.indianrailways.gov.in and go to About Us → RRC-SCR to open the ONLINE ACT APPRENTICE APPLICATION link.
  2. Read the detailed SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 notification carefully and ensure you belong to the eligible states/districts and possess required 10th + ITI qualification.
  3. Complete Registration: select state and district, upload address proof, enter valid mobile number and email ID, create a password and verify OTPs sent to mobile and email.
  4. Login as a registered candidate and fill in personal details (name, DOB, category, etc.) and educational/technical details (10th marks, ITI trade, ITI marks, RDAT registration number).
  5. Select your priority/preference of training units (Divisions/Workshops/Sheds) only for trades you are eligible for; options once submitted cannot be changed.
  6. Upload a recent colour photograph (JPEG, ≤1 MB, not older than 3 months), signature image (≤1 MB) and required certificates (10th, ITI, RDAT form, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, medical certificate) in PDF format (≤2 MB).
  7. Ensure you have completed RDAT/NAPS registration at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and obtained registration number before filling the SCR apprentice application.
  8. Check all details in the Preview page carefully; after clicking Submit, no modification will be allowed.
  9. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through online payment gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI) and generate e-receipt.
  10. Download/print the final submitted SCR Apprentice application form 2026 and keep it along with fee receipt and uploaded documents for Document Verification.

Asstt Director (EDP)

How to Apply Online for Mumbai Port Authority Recruitment 2026

Applications will be accepted online only from 06/03/2026 to 06/04/2026 through the Mumbai Port Authority website.

  • Log in with the credentials, fill in personal, educational and experience details carefully and use the “Save and Next” option to verify entries before final submission.
  • Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per the size and format guidelines given in Annexure III of the advertisement.
  • Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the prescribed application fee/intimation charges online using Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets.
  • After successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated; download and print both the e-Receipt and the final submitted application form containing fee details for future reference.

Candidates are advised to ensure they meet all eligibility conditions (age, qualification, experience, physical requirements) before applying; appearing in the online examination will not confer any right of selection if they are found ineligible at any stage.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Medical Officer (Group-B):
    • Essential Qualification: M.B.B.S Degree from a Statutory University or any other qualification recognized under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019 (30 of 2019).
    • Registration: Must have registered names as per provisions of the Maharashtra Medical Council Act, 1965, or whose names have been registered in the register maintained under the said Act.
  • Additional Public Prosecutor (Group-A):
    • Essential Qualification: Degree in Law.
    • Experience: Experience of working as an Advocate in the High Court or in a Court Subordinate thereto for a period of eight years.
    • Nature of Job: Advocate.
  • Motor Vehicle Prosecutor (Group-A):
    • Essential Qualification: Degree in Law.
    • Experience: Practical experience for a minimum period of seven years as an Advocate after acquiring Certificate of Practice granted by the State or Indian Bar Council.
    • Nature of Job: Advocate.
  • Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer / Deputy Director (Group-A):
    • Essential Qualification: Must have ceased to be a serving member of the Armed Forces of the Union and must have held the rank of Major and above in the Army, or rank equivalent thereto in the Navy or Air Force.
    • Language: Must have adequate knowledge of Marathi so as to be able to speak, read and write the language with facility.
    • Relaxation: If an officer of the requisite rank is not available, an officer holding the rank of Lieutenant and above in the Army or equivalent rank in the Navy or Air Force may also be considered.
  • Deputy Executive Health Officer – MCGM (Group-B):
    • Nature of Job: Responsible position in Health Administration OR Assistant Health Officer.
    • Eligibility as per MPSC / MCGM official notification.
  • Deputy Medical Superintendent – MCGM T.B. Hospital (Group-A):
    • Nature of Job: Chief Medical Officer in T.B. Hospital OR Senior Medical Officer in T.B. Hospital OR Medical Officer in T.B. Hospital OR Practical and Administrative experience in T.B. Hospital.

  • Medical Officer (Group-B): Minimum 18; Maximum 45 for Open, 50 for Reserved.
  • Deputy Executive Health Officer (Group-B): Minimum 19; Maximum 38 for Open, 43 for Reserved.
  • District Sainik Welfare Officer / Deputy Director (Group-A):  Maximum 55 years for all categories.
  • Motor Vehicle Prosecutor (Group-A): Minimum 19; Maximum 38 for Open, 43 for Reserved.
  • Additional Public Prosecutor (Group-A): Minimum 18; Maximum 38 for Open, 43 for Reserved.
  • Age limit for all posts is as per the Government of Maharashtra / MPSC rules applicable to the respective Group (Group-A / Group-B).
  • Age relaxation is applicable for reserved category candidates (SC, ST, OBC, VJ, NT, EWS, Divyang, Ex-Servicemen, Women, Sports, Orphan) as per Government rules.

General Information / Instructions

  • The social / parallel reservation details for all posts mentioned above are as per the Government's requisition and are subject to change as per Government instructions.
  • If there is any change in the number of posts or reservation details received from the Government, the same will be published on the MPSC website and the recruitment process will be carried out accordingly.
  • Social reservation for various backward classes, Women, Sports persons, Orphans, etc. shall be as per the orders issued by the Government from time to time.
  • Candidates claiming reservation under Vimukta Jati (A), Bhatakya Jamati (B), Bhatakya Jamati (K), and Bhatakya Jamati (D) categories must ensure they are not advanced and progressive persons / group in society. They must submit a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate as per the prescribed format given by the competent authority.
  • As per the Government decision of Women and Child Development Department, Govt. circular No. MAHIA-2023/Pra.Kra.123/Karya-2, dated 04 May 2023, the requirement of submitting Non-Creamy Layer certificate for reserved women candidates applying for reserved posts has been withdrawn.
  • SC / ST women wishing to claim reservation for reserved posts must submit Non-Creamy Layer certificate from the concerned Backward Class Welfare Department and the General Administration Department as specified.
  • Women candidates wishing to claim female reservation benefits must mandatorily be domiciled residents of Maharashtra and must clearly state in the application that they are domiciled in Maharashtra (Domiciled) and also clearly state their SC / ST or other backward class status if applicable.
  • Posts reserved for Vimukta Jati (A), Bhatakya Jamati (B), Bhatakya Jamati (K), and Bhatakya Jamati (D) are inter-transferable. If eligible candidates from the reserved category are not available, candidates from the available category will be considered on the basis of merit.
  • If a caste / tribe is declared eligible for State Government reservation and a certificate issued by the competent authority is available with the candidate, such caste / tribe candidates may be eligible for reservation benefits.

How to Apply

  • After successful fee payment, candidates must ensure the payment status reflects as "Payment Successful" on the MPSC portal before logging out.
  • Candidates must submit their applications within the stipulated time period as specified in the official notification — late applications will not be entertained.
  • Candidates are strongly advised to read the full official notification of the respective post carefully before filling and submitting the application form.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification:
    • B.Sc Nursing Course with MNC (Maharashtra Nursing Council) Registration.
  • Registration:
    • For medical/paramedical posts, registration with the concerned Medical/Paramedical Council is mandatory. Certificate of registration from the concerned council must be submitted along with the application form and originals must be produced if shortlisted.
  • Computer Qualification:
    • Candidates holding MS-CIT certificate must mention the details and attach the certificate with the application.
  • Educational Qualification Requirements:
    • Educational qualifications for contractual posts must be obtained from UGC-Approved Universities only.
    • Detailed educational qualifications must be accurately noted in the application form.
    • Candidates must possess the required minimum educational qualification as on the last date of application submission.
    • The date on which the required educational qualification was obtained must be mentioned in the application (i.e., the date of declaration of result).
    • If grade or class is mentioned in the final year mark sheet, it must be converted to percentage by the issuing institution, certified, and the proportion/percentage noted accordingly in the application.
    • Applications where percentage noted in the form does not match the percentage noted in the mark sheet will be rejected.
    • All self-attested photocopies of educational certificates must be attached along with the application. If shortlisted, original documents must be produced at the time of document verification.
  • Experience:
    • Only experience gained after acquiring the required educational qualification for the post applied for will be considered.
    • Experience must be listed from current appointment to first appointment in chronological order.
    • Experience certificate from the concerned office/institution is mandatory — experience without a certificate will not be considered.
    • The experience certificate must clearly mention the period of experience.
    • Date of joining and date of relieving must be accurately mentioned; both dates should match the experience certificate.
    • Only experience related to the post applied for (government/semi-government) will be considered.
  • Language:
    • Knowledge of Marathi language is required.
  • Domicile:
    • Candidate must be a domicile resident of Maharashtra State. A self-attested photocopy of Domicile Certificate must be submitted along with the application.

Salary/Stipend

    • Marks in Required Qualifying Exam (Final Year) – Maximum 50 Marks: Proportion of total marks obtained will be calculated out of 50. (Example: If 60% marks obtained, Proportion = 60 × 50 / 100 = 30 marks)
    • Additional Educational Qualification above required qualification (in same subject) – Maximum 20 Marks: Proportion of marks in additional qualification will be calculated out of 20. (Example: If 60% in additional qualification, Proportion = 60 × 20 / 100 = 12 marks)
    • Relevant Work Experience – Maximum 30 Marks: 6 marks per year of experience (maximum 30 marks for 5 or more years of experience).

  • Deputy General Manager – Technical Services – R&D (3.23): 4-year full-time regular engineering course in Chemical Engineering. Desirable: 2-year full-time regular MBA course.
  • Deputy General Manager – Polymer Export (3.24): 2-year full-time regular MBA course in Sales / Marketing / Operations / Supply Chain AND Minimum 3-year full-time graduation in any discipline.
  • Assistant Manager / Manager – IS (Data Management, Cyber Security, Quality Assurance) (3.25, 3.26, 3.27): 4-year full-time regular engineering course in Computer Science and Engineering OR full-time Masters in Computer Applications (MCA).
  • Manager / Senior Manager – IS (Enterprise Architect) (3.28): 4-year full-time regular engineering course in Computer Science and Engineering OR full-time Masters in Computer Applications (MCA).
  • Assistant Manager / Manager / Senior Manager – HR (3.29): 2-year full-time Post Graduate Degree / Equivalent course in HR / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Psychology or MBA with specialization in HR.
  • Senior Cyber Security Strategist & Advisor – IT and OT (FTC) (4.1): 4-year full-time regular engineering course in Computer Science and Engineering OR Full-time Masters in Computer Applications (MCA). Desirable: 2-year full-time regular Masters in Cyber Security / Information Security / OT Security.
  • Minimum Marks: CA/CMA – Minimum 50% marks in CA/CMA AND Minimum 65% marks for UR/OBCNC/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates in Graduation. All other positions – Minimum 65% marks for UR/OBCNC/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.
  • All qualifications must be full-time regular courses from AICTE approved / UGC recognized University / Deemed University.

Salary / Stipend

  • Pay Scale ₹30,000 – ₹1,20,000: CTC Approx. ₹10.88 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000: CTC Approx. ₹14.51 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000: CTC Approx. ₹18.14 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000: CTC Approx. ₹21.77 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹70,000 – ₹2,00,000: CTC Approx. ₹26.24 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹80,000 – ₹2,20,000: CTC Approx. ₹29.98 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹90,000 – ₹2,40,000: CTC Approx. ₹34.81 Lakh per annum
  • Pay Scale ₹1,20,000 – ₹2,80,000: CTC Approx. ₹49.30 Lakh per annum
  • FTC Position (Senior Cyber Security Strategist & Advisor): Annual Consolidated Remuneration of ₹50 Lakhs or ₹60 Lakhs per annum (depending on experience level).
  • A candidate will be inducted at the minimum of the pay scale.
  • The CTC includes Basic Pay, Retirement Benefits, Dearness Allowance, HRA, Cafeteria Allowance, and Performance Related Pay (at maximum), payable as per Corporation's policy.
  • The above CTC is for candidates posted in metro cities and may vary for other locations.

Age Limit (as on 25-03-2026)

  • Junior Executive (All Freshers Posts – 2.1 to 2.8): Maximum Age – 25 Years
  • Engineer Posts (2.9 to 2.12): Maximum Age – 25 Years
  • Officer – Finance / HR / IS (2.13 to 2.17): Maximum Age – 25 to 27 Years (varies by post)
  • Experienced Professionals (3.1 to 3.29): Maximum age varies from 26 to 47 years depending upon the position and completed years of experience as per the table in the notification.
  • FTC – Senior Cyber Security Strategist & Advisor (4.1): Maximum Age – 39 to 45 Years (depending on experience)
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC / ST candidates: 5 years relaxation
    • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates: 3 years relaxation
    • PwBD (UR): 10 years relaxation
    • PwBD (OBCNC): 13 years relaxation
    • PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years relaxation
    • Candidates domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir between 01.01.1980 and 31.12.1989: 5 years relaxation
    • Ex-Servicemen & Commissioned Officers: 5 years relaxation (subject to conditions)
    • Maximum upper age of applicants shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations.

Application Fee

  • UR / OBCNC / EWS Candidates: ₹1180/- (Application Fee of ₹1000/- + GST @18% i.e. ₹180/-) + Payment Gateway Charges if any. Non-Refundable.
  • SC / ST / PwBD Candidates: Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Payment Mode: Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking (Online only).
  • On successful payment, status will change to "Your Transaction is successfully completed".
  • Candidates must ensure payment status is "Completed".
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • No other mode of payment than those mentioned above will be accepted.

Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 25th February 2026 (1300 hours onwards)
Last Date of Online Application 25th March 2026 (Up to 2359 hours)
Computer Based Test (CBT) (Tentative) 3rd May 2026

Selection Process

  • The selection process may comprise of various shortlisting and selection tools such as Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Test / Typing Test, Group Task, Psychometric Assessment, Skill Test, Moot Court, Personal/Technical Interview, Physical Fitness Efficiency Test (if applicable) etc., depending upon the position requirement.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): Consists of objective questions (subjective as well for Legal HR Officers) and comprises two parts:
    • Part I – General Aptitude: English Language, Quantitative Aptitude Test & Intellectual Potential Test (Logical Reasoning and Data Interpretation).
    • Part II – Technical / Professional Knowledge: Questions related to qualifying degree / educational background required for the applied position.
  • CBT will be conducted tentatively on 3rd May 2026. HPCL reserves the right to reschedule the date of CBT.
  • Questions will be based on syllabus hosted on Careers Page on corporate website (indicative, not exhaustive).
  • Candidates qualifying in CBT, in order of merit and predetermined ratio, will be advised to upload supporting documents for certain positions.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Group Task and/or Personal Interview based on scrutiny of application, uploaded documents, and merit list.
  • Candidates' document verification shall be conducted before Personal Interviews.
  • Candidates may be required to undergo Psychometric Assessments before/after Group Task/Personal Interview.
  • Candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in each applicable selection stage (CBT, Group Task, and Personal Interview) to be considered for further selection.
  • A category and discipline-wise merit list will be drawn for all candidates who qualify in all applicable stages.
  • The selected candidates would be required to join HPCL as per the date of joining mentioned in the Offer of Appointment.

General Information / Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All computations of age / relevant experience / qualification shall be done with respect to the last date of receipt of online application i.e. 25th March 2026.
  • All qualifications should be full-time regular courses from AICTE approved / UGC recognized University / Deemed University.
  • Teaching & Research experience in an academic institute will not be considered as relevant work experience.
  • Candidates currently employed at HPCL are not eligible to apply for Lateral Positions (positions where minimum experience is sought).
  • Selected candidates will be on Probation for one year from the Date of Joining.
  • Selected candidates will have to execute a service bond to serve the corporation for a minimum period of three years. Bond Amount: General – ₹3,00,000/-; EWS/OBC(NC)/SC/ST/PwBD – ₹50,000/-.
  • A Retention Amount of ₹5,000/- per month will be deducted for Pay Scales ₹30,000–1,20,000 or ₹40,000–1,40,000 during the first 12 months of probation.
  • A Retention Amount of ₹8,000/- per month will be deducted for Pay Scales from ₹50,000–1,60,000 till ₹90,000–2,40,000 during the first 12 months of probation.
  • Appointment is subject to candidate being medically fit as per standards prescribed by the Corporation.
  • Candidates would be required to clear Physical Fitness Efficiency Test (PFET) comprising Working at Height Test, Endurance Test, and Agility Test after PEME (wherever applicable).
  • Depending upon the requirement of the Corporation, selected candidates can be placed anywhere in India or overseas at the discretion of the Management.
  • Maximum upper age of applicants shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Mumbai.
  • Any further corrigendum / addendum would be uploaded only on www.hindustanpetroleum.com.

How to Apply

  • Online Application will be accepted from 1300 hrs on 25th February 2026 till 2359 hrs on 25th March 2026.
  • Candidates are requested to apply online only at www.hindustanpetroleum.com → Careers → Current Openings, after reading the detailed advertisement.
  • No other means / mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Applications with incomplete / wrong particulars or not in the prescribed format will not be considered.
  • The email ID and mobile number provided in the online application should remain valid for at least one year. Applications with pseudo / fake email IDs will attract appropriate action under the law.
  • Upload the photograph and signature of the candidate during application. In case of wrong / missing photo / signature, the candidature will be cancelled.
  • All details given in the online form will be treated as final and no changes will be entertained.
  • Pay the applicable application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking and ensure the payment status shows "Completed". Take a printout of the acknowledgment of payment for future reference.
  • Queries must be emailed with subject formatted as "Position Name – Application Number" at [email protected].
  • Candidates are advised to apply online well before the closing date and not wait till the last date.
  • Candidates currently employed in Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies must submit their application through proper process and produce No Objection Certificate at the time of Personal Interview.

HEF Khadki Eligibility Criteria 2026

Post Age Limit

HEF Khadki Educational & Professional Qualification 2026

Supervisory Staff (Graduate Project Engineer – Chemical)

A) Essential Qualification:

  • B.E./B.Tech in Chemical from a recognized institution.
  • Ex-Graduate Apprentice who has undergone minimum one year training as per Apprenticeship Act 1961 in Chemical trade of Ordnance Factories under MIL or Ordnance Factories manufacturing Military Ammunitions and Explosives. OR Persons with one year training/experience in Factories manufacturing Military Ammunitions and Explosives will be engaged on Tenure basis as Graduate Project Engineer.

B) Criteria for Engagement: Persons with minimum one year experience or training in factories manufacturing ammunition, explosives and hazardous chemicals and handling of the same. Ex-Graduate Apprentice of Chemical trade who have completed one year Trade Apprenticeship in Ordnance Factories under MIL or factories manufacturing ammunition and explosives possess skill.

Skilled Worker (AOCP – Attendant Operator Chemical Plant)

A) Essential Qualification:

  • Matriculation + NAC/NTC issued by NCTVT (now NCVT) having completed the course from government/private organization having affiliation from government, and those from Government ITI.
  • Trade: AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant)
  • Feeder Trades: IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic.

B) Desirable: Possessing Ordnance Factories training or experience in manufacturing and handling military explosives and ammunitions.

HEF Khadki Selection Process 2026

For Supervisory Staff (Graduate Project Engineer):

  • Selection based on Marks scored in B.E./B.Tech and Personal Interaction/Interview only, in order of Merit.
  • Weightage: B.E./B.Tech marks – 85%; Personal Interaction/Interview – 15%.
  • Cut-off percentage for calling candidates for interview may be decided by HEF based on marks in qualifying examination to ensure sufficient competition.
  • Merit list prepared on combined marks of B.E./B.Tech and Personal Interaction/Interview.
  • Candidates scoring more than cut-off marks will be called for Document Verification in order of merit; number limited to posts notified (Discipline/Category wise).
  • Candidates qualifying Document Verification will be issued Offers of Engagement.

For Skilled Worker (AOCP – CPW):

  • Selection based on Marks scored in NCVT and Trade Test/Practical Test only, in order of Merit.
  • Weightage: NCVT Exam – 80%; Trade Test/Practical Test – 20%.
  • Cut-off for Trade Test/Practical Test decided by HEF based on total marks in NCVT.
  • Merit list prepared on combined marks in NCVT Exam and Trade Test/Practical Test.
  • Candidates with AOCP Trade (NCVT) will be given preference; candidates from feeder trades considered only if requisite number of AOCP candidates not available.
  • AOCP Trade Apprentices from Government/Private organisations will be given compulsory "ONE MONTH" extensive in-house training on Safe Handling of Explosives, ammunition, safety norms, DOs & DON'Ts, etc. After successful completion, two months On-Job training will be imparted, after which they will be considered for specific job deployment.
  • On successful completion of training, a Certificate will be issued acceptable in all MIL Group of Factories.

Remuneration & Benefits

  • Remuneration at 1/30th of Basic Pay + Dearness Allowance for 8 hours work per day.
  • IDA as prevalent will be applicable.
  • House Rent Allowance as per classification of cities (when Company Quarter is not available). Priority for Company Quarters where available.
  • 30 days leave per year (2.5 days per calendar month of service); can be accumulated up to 30 days and encashed after completion of one year.
  • Eligible for EPF and Employees Compensation Act as per government guidelines.
  • Bonus (as applicable) as per Bonus Act 1965.
  • Night Duty Allowance at par with regular employees (for Night Shift due to production exigency).
  • Risk Allowance at par with regular employees as per extant rules.
  • Safety and protective gear, equipment, kits as per Company norms.
  • Maternity Benefits for female personnel as per Maternity Benefit Act, 1961.
  • Company Quarters eligibility (wherever available); license fee deducted at rates applicable to regular employees.

NOT entitled for: Promotions, OT allowance, Loans/Advances/Interest Subsidies, Medical Facilities, Contingency Advance, School Fee Reimbursement, LTC/LTA Facilities, Grant of Study Leave, Sponsorship for Higher Studies, or any other benefits admissible to regular employees.

Terms & Conditions of Tenure Engagement

  • Engagement on contract basis initially for One Year; extendable for another Three Years (total maximum Four Years) with yearly renewal based on factory requirement and individual performance.
  • Tenure ends automatically on completion of four years from date of joining, without any further notice.
  • Employment can be terminated at any time during tenure by giving one month's notice by either side or payment of Basic Pay + IDA Component in lieu of Notice.
  • No commitment to the candidate either for absorption as permanent employee or for extension of term.
  • Performance assessed on a six-monthly basis; poor performance will result in written notice to improve; repeated poor rating may lead to termination.
  • Full-time basis; absence other than authorized leave/Company Holidays will result in proportionate reduction in Consolidated Emoluments.
  • For quitting the job, candidate must give one month prior notice in advance, failing which one month salary will be deducted.
  • Tenure Based Personnel will abide by various Company/Factory Rules & Regulations governing the assigned tasks and conduct.
  • Personnel covered under Income Tax, Service Tax, Professional Tax as per applicable rules; all such taxes payable by candidates.

How to Apply for HEF Khadki Recruitment 2026

  1. Download and print the Application Form from the link provided.
  2. Fill the application form in BLOCK LETTERS only.
  3. Self-attest one extra copy of photograph (behind the photograph) and enclose with the application.
  4. Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualifications, age proof certificate, experience certificate from institutions, NCVT Marksheets and National Trade Certificate (NTC)/National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) as applicable.
  5. OBC candidates must submit duly signed undertaking in the format given at Appendix-I of the Application Form. Valid OBC-NCL/EWS certificate as per extant rules (as on closing date of application) required at time of Document Verification.
  6. Superscribe the envelope clearly as: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF 'TENURE BASED SUPERVISORY STAFF / SKILLED WORKER ON CONTRACT BASIS'"
  7. Send the hard copy of the application to reach on or before the last date of receipt of application to:
    The Chief General Manager,
    High Explosives Factory,
    Khadki, Pune, Maharashtra Pin – 411003

Important Instructions

  • Application fee is NIL for all candidates.
  • Submission of more than one application by the same individual for a post will be summarily rejected.
  • Submission of false/incorrect/incomplete information or dubious/bogus documents shall disqualify the candidature.
  • SC/ST candidates shall be paid second-class TA as admissible under rules in the shortest route of travel, on production of bus/train ticket and Caste/Community Certificate. Mandatory to submit 'Bank Details Form' for reimbursement of TA claim.
  • No correspondence/enquiry through phone/messenger will be entertained; canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Mere submission of application form does not guarantee issue of 'Call Letter' for Trade Test/Practical Test; only shortlisted candidates will be informed.
  • Candidates appearing for Physical Test/Trade Test/Skill Test will have to travel on their own expenses and are required to stay one day more for medical examination.
  • HEF Khadki will not be responsible for late/non-receipt of filled-in application/Call Letters due to postal delay or any other reasons.

India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 must satisfy all eligibility conditions related to nationality, age, educational qualification and experience as on the closing date of the advertisement.

  • Nationality: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
  • Age Limit: 18 to 35 years as on the closing date of the advertisement.
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other categories as per Government of India directives and applicable reservation rules.
  • Educational Qualification – Chemical: First class (minimum 60%) full-time regular B.Sc degree in Chemistry from a recognized university with at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Electrical: Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Plant Maintenance Engineering with minimum 60% marks and at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Electronics: Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Instrumentation / Industrial Electronics & Instrumentation with minimum 60% marks and at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Mechanical: Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering / Mechatronics with minimum 60% marks and at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Educational Qualification – Optics & Coating: First class (minimum 60%) full-time regular B.Sc degree with Physics and Mathematics as major subjects from a recognized university with at least 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
  • Marks Relaxation: General/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must have at least 60% aggregate marks; SC/ST/PwBD candidates must have at least 50% aggregate marks in the essential qualification.
  • Course Type: Only full-time regular courses recognized by AICTE/UGC/State Boards or appropriate statutory authorities will be considered.

India Optel Limited Junior Project Engineer Salary 2026

  • Junior Project Engineers engaged under India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 will be placed in Pay Level ₹30,000 – ₹1,20,000, along with Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA).
  • They will be eligible for House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable rates where company accommodation is not allotted.
  • Medical Allowance of ₹1,500 per month is payable, subject to conditions for retired Govt. employees/Ex-servicemen with respect to CGHS/ECHS/Defence Forces NOC.
  • An annual increment of 3% of basic pay (rounded to the next ten) is admissible during the tenure, based on satisfactory performance and recommendation of the competent authority.

Tenure of Engagement

  • The initial engagement on Fixed Term Contract basis will be for up to 2 years, depending on requirement.
  • Extension in engagement may be granted for periods up to 1 year at a time, subject to requirement and performance evaluation, with the total tenure not exceeding 5 years including initial term and extensions.
  • IOL reserves the right to terminate the contract before completion of the term in case of unsatisfactory performance or misconduct, with notice as per conditions in the advertisement.

Place of Posting

Selected candidates for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 will normally be posted at Opto Electronics Factory (OLF) and Ordnance Factory Dehradun (OFD), units of India Optel Limited located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. However, depending on organizational requirements, they may be posted, transferred, attached or deputed to other locations with the approval of the competent authority.

India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Screening: Applications will be screened by a Screening Committee, and only eligible candidates will be considered.
  • Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview, generally up to 1.5 times the number of vacancies, based on percentage of marks in Diploma/B.Sc (as applicable).
  • Interview: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview, for which call letters will be sent through email.
  • Final Merit: Final merit will be prepared using 75% weightage for Diploma/B.Sc percentage and 25% weightage for interview performance.
  • Document Verification: Original documents will be verified before interview; any shortcomings or discrepancies will result in rejection of candidature.
  • Tie-breaking: In case of equal scores, the elder candidate (by date of birth) will be placed higher; if DOB is also same, alphabetical order of names will be considered.

Application Fee

  • There is no application fee (NIL) for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 Junior Project Engineer posts.

How to Apply India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 (Junior Project Engineer)

Applications for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026 are accepted offline only in the prescribed application format (Annexure “A”). Follow the steps given below.

  1. Download Application Form: Visit the DOO (C&S) website at https://ddpdoo.gov.in, go to the “Join Us” tab and download the application format (Annexure “A”) attached with the advertisement.
  2. Fill in Block Letters: Fill the application completely in BLOCK LETTERS, giving correct personal details, category, educational qualifications, post applied for, and experience information.
  3. Attach Photograph: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form and self-attest it as specified.
  4. Attach Self-attested Documents: Enclose self-attested photocopies of:
    • Valid proof of date of birth (Matriculation/Secondary school certificate or Birth Certificate)
    • Educational mark sheets and degree/diploma certificates (10th onwards)
    • Experience certificates, joining/relieving letters, salary slips/statement, PPO (for retired candidates), etc., showing relevant post-qualification experience
    • Caste/category certificate for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS, PwBD certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate (if applicable)
  5. Check Email and Mobile: Clearly mention a valid and active email ID and mobile number which will remain in use throughout the engagement process, as all important communication will be sent via email.
  6. Separate Applications: If applying for more than one discipline/position, submit a separate application for each.
  7. Superscribe Envelope: Put the filled application and enclosures in an envelope clearly superscribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________ ON FIXED TERM CONTRACT BASIS”.
  8. Send by Speed Post Only: Send the application by Speed Post only to the following address so that it reaches within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News:Postal Address: The Chairman & Managing Director, India Optel Limited, OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) – 248008
  9. Applications received after the closing date, incomplete applications, applications without required enclosures, not in the prescribed format or with incorrect information are liable to be rejected without any correspondence.

Important Instructions & Rejection Conditions

  • Applications not meeting eligibility criteria, received after the last date, or not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected and IOL will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Incomplete, illegible applications or those without self-attested copies of required certificates will not be considered.
  • Any variation in name/surname between application and certificates, or any false/incorrect information or dubious documents, will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who do not fulfil the eligibility conditions at any stage will be disqualified ab-initio and no correspondence will be entertained regarding non-selection.

Nature of Engagement & Termination

  • The engagement is purely on Fixed Term Contract basis and does not confer any right for regular or permanent employment in India Optel Limited.
  • The engagement automatically ends on completion of the contract term unless extended, and may be terminated earlier for poor performance, misconduct, breach of company rules or prolonged unauthorized absence.
  • The contract can be terminated by giving notice (or payment in lieu) as specified in the advertisement: generally 3 months by the FTC employee and 1 month by the company.

  • Rail Wheel Factory Administration is the nodal agency for processing of applications from candidates and preparation of their merit list.
  • Before commencement of the Apprenticeship training, selected candidates have to execute a Contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer. If the candidate is a Minor, then his/her guardian has to enter into a contract of Apprenticeship with the Employer.
  • Selected candidates are required to register the contract of Apprenticeship in online mode at the Apprenticeship portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/candidate-login. Candidates are advised to register at the earliest without waiting for the final select list to be published.
  • On completion of training, the candidate, on passing a test to be conducted by NCVT in Vocational Trades, will be given a certificate of proficiency in the trade by the National Council.
  • Candidates should ensure that their Name, Father's/Mother's name/Guardian's name and Date of Birth in the application form exactly match as recorded in their Matriculation or equivalent certificates and other certificates including Aadhaar certificates. Any deviation found during document verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment from undergoing training.
  • Reservation and age relaxation for various categories/communities is as per the Govt. of India Rules for the purpose and as revised by the Railway Board from time to time.
  • Candidates employed in Government / Quasi-Government / PSU should send their application through proper channel.
  • Candidates will have no claim to seek employment on Railways on the basis of such training as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • No Hostel facility will be provided. The selected candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay during their period of training.
  • The candidates attending the office for verification of documents will not be paid any TA/DA.
  • The caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the form notified by the Government of India. If the caste certified by the candidate does not appear in the Central Gazette, then he/she will be treated as belonging to 'UR' community.
  • The applicant should submit only one application form. Multiple applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates are required to furnish the correct and complete postal address with Pin Code in their application.
  • The list of selected candidates will be displayed at https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. Important messages will be sent by SMS/E-mail.
  • Help Desk: For any queries related to the submission of applications, candidates can call on 080-28072616 from 09:00 hrs. to 16:50 hrs. (Monday to Friday) on all working days and from 09:00 hrs. to 12:20 hrs. on Saturday (except Sundays and Holidays).

Documents Required (Self-Attested Photocopies)

  • 10th Std / Matriculation or its equivalent marks certificate with at least 50% marks, with Date of Birth as proof of age.
  • National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the designated trade issued by NCVT.
  • Copy of caste certificate (SC/ST candidates in proforma Annexure-B and OBC candidates in proforma Annexure-C).
  • Physically Handicapped / Disability certificate duly issued by the competent medical board.
  • Two identical passport size photographs duly self-attested and firmly stitched in a separate cover to the application form (apart from one copy pasted on the application form).
  • Discharge certificate / serving certificate for wards of Ex-Servicemen / serving Railway employee.
  • Employment Registration card, registered in Employment Exchanges within the State of Karnataka (for Karnataka candidates) or respective local employment exchanges (for other state candidates), with renewal being current.
  • Wards of serving Railway employees should produce a certificate issued by the respective controlling officers in proforma Annexure-D.
  • IPO / Demand Draft of ₹100/- as processing fee (where applicable).

How to Apply

  • Download the Application Form (Annexure-A) and all other Annexures (B, C, D & E) from the official website of Rail Wheel Factory: https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. No other format shall be entertained.
  • Fill the application form carefully. Ensure that Name, Father's/Mother's/Guardian's name and Date of Birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation and other certificates. Any deviation will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Affix a recent colour passport size photograph duly signed/attested by the candidate on the application form.
  • Enclose all required self-attested documents including 10th marks sheet, NTC, caste certificate, Employment Exchange registration card, photographs and IPO/DD as applicable.
  • Fill and sign the checklist in Annexure-F. Applications submitted without duly filled in checklist and signed by the candidate will not be considered.
  • The application (Annexure-A) can either be dropped in the sealed Drop Box kept in the Office of the Principal Chief Personnel Officer, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore-560064 on all working days (Monday to Friday: 09:00 hrs to 16:50 hrs; Saturday: 09:00 hrs to 12:20 hrs).
  • Alternatively, the application can be sent by REGISTERED POST ONLY to the below address, superscribing on the cover as "Application for undergoing training under the Apprentices' Act, 1961 for the year 2025-26 in Rail Wheel Factory":
    The Senior Personnel Officer-II, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore – 560 064.
  • Applications should be submitted to this office before 17:00 hrs. of the closing date i.e., 01.04.2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to submit applications well in advance before the closing date to avoid last minute rush.

Vacancy Details

High Court of Allahabad has announced the recruitment of Special Judicial Magistrates for two districts in Uttar Pradesh. These positions are on a fixed honorarium basis with conveyance allowance.
