Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 09.02.2026
Application Submission Last Date 13-04-2026
Selection Process Merit-based by High Court
Term of Office 4 Years or Age 70 years

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:
    • Full name, father's name, date of birth
    • Current and permanent residential addresses with PIN codes
    • Email address and mobile number
    • Details of posts held under the Government (designation, pay scale, duration, retirement date)
    • Educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, LL.B., and any other qualifications)
    • Whether previously worked as SJM/SMM with year-wise details and annual confidential report percentages
  5. Mention whether any criminal case is pending or FIR lodged
  6. Sign the declaration that all information provided is correct

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

  • Photocopies of all relevant documents mentioned in the application
  • Character roll entries of the last 5 years of Government service (if applicable)
  • Law degree certificate and other educational qualification certificates
  • Copy of Gazette notification of Government service record
  • For ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment: Four best judgments delivered as SJM/SMM

  2. Do NOT send applications directly to the High Court — applications sent directly to High Court will be rejected
  3. Submit to the following District Judges based on your choice:

Salary

  • For all tenure-based ITI posts (Machinist and other trades), the consolidated monthly salary is based on Basic Pay of Rs 18,000 at 7th CPC Level‑1 plus applicable Dearness Allowance (DA) as per Government rules.

  • The pay is treated as consolidated for contract employees, and an annual increase of 3% on the Basic Pay is admissible during the tenure, subject to satisfactory performance in half‑yearly evaluations.

  • Remuneration is calculated at the rate of 1/30th of Basic Pay plus DA for 8 hours of work per day, and proportionate deductions are made for unauthorised leave or absence; contract personnel are also eligible for company holidays at par with regular employees.

  • If company quarters are not provided, HRA is payable, and where quarters are allotted, licence fee is deducted at rates applicable to regular workmen.

Selection Process

  • Selection for all 151 tenure-based ITI posts is purely merit-based, combining NCTVT/NCVT marks and Trade/Practical Test performance.

  • First, candidates are shortlisted for Trade/Practical Test on the basis of total marks obtained in the NCTVT/NCVT exam; the cut‑off percentage for calling candidates is decided by Ordnance Factory Kanpur.

  • A Trade/Practical Test is then conducted for the relevant trade (Machinist, Examiner, Electrician, etc.) at Ordnance Factory Kanpur to assess hands‑on skills.

  • The final merit list is prepared using combined scores with 80% weightage to NCTVT/NCVT exam marks and 20% weightage to the Trade/Practical Test.

  • Candidates placed in merit are called for Document Verification, where all original certificates and eligibility conditions are checked; if some candidates are rejected at this stage, additional candidates in order of merit may be called until all notified posts are covered.

  • The application fee is Rs 100 per candidate, to be paid via Demand Draft in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR” for both advertisements.

    • Any other documents specified in the notifications.

  • Paste the required photograph on the form and enclose two extra self‑attested passport-size photographs as instructed.

  • Prepare the application fee Demand Draft of Rs 100 (where applicable) in favour of “ORDNANCE FACTORY KANPUR”; SC/ST, Ex‑Servicemen and PwD candidates are exempt from the fee.

  • Place the filled form, DD and documents in an envelope clearly superscribed with the relevant post, for example:

  • Send the envelope by post to: The Chief General Manager,Ordnance Factory Kanpur,Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh – 208009, ensuring it reaches on or before 08 April 2026; applications received after the last date or incomplete/unsigned are liable to be rejected.

UPSSSC ASO/ARO Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility criteria include PET qualification, age limit, educational qualification and other conditions. All conditions must be fulfilled as on the last date of application.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Particulars Details
Minimum Age 21 years (as on 1st July of the advertisement year)

Age Relaxation – State Government Employees 5 years additional relaxation
Age Relaxation – Ex-Servicemen As per UP Reservation Act 1993
Age Relaxation – CM Fellowship Research Scholars As per UP notification dated 30 January 2026

Note: Candidates who are not domiciled in Uttar Pradesh will NOT be eligible for any reservation benefit and will be treated as General/Unreserved category candidates.

UPSSSC ASO/ARO Educational Qualification 2026

Educational qualifications must be fulfilled as on the last date of application (11 May 2026).

  • Mandatory Academic Qualification: Post-Graduate degree or equivalent from a legally established Indian university in — Mathematics / Mathematical Statistics / Commerce / Economics / Statistics, OR any government-recognized equivalent qualification. (Refer Annexure-1 for full list of 51 accepted PG qualifications including MBA, M.Com, M.Sc. Statistics, M.A. Economics, etc.)
  • Mandatory Computer Qualification: 'O' Level Diploma from DOEACC/NIELIT Society OR at least one-year Diploma in Computer Science from a recognized university/institution.
  • Mandatory Language: Knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script.
  • Preferential (Adhimani) Qualification: Minimum 2 years service in Pradeshik Sena OR 'B' certificate of NCC.

UPSSSC ASO/ARO Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC ASO/ARO Selection Process 2026 is a two-stage process:

  • Stage 1 – Shortlisting: Based on PET-2025 normalized score. Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025 and have been issued a score card by the Commission are eligible. Candidates with zero, negative, or absent marks in PET-2025 will not be shortlisted. 15 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for the Main Exam.
  • Stage 2 – Main Written Examination: 100 objective/MCQ questions, 100 marks, 2 hours duration. Negative marking: 25% (¼ mark deducted per wrong answer).
  • Stage 3 – Document Verification.

How to Apply for UPSSSC ASO/ARO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit official UPSSSC website upsssc.gov.in → Homepage → Live Advertisement Segment → Click on Advertisement No. 05-परीक्षा/2026.
  2. Login using your PET-2025 Registration Number and OTP sent to registered mobile/email.
  3. Select the posts/departments you wish to apply for and fill all mandatory details.
  4. Verify photo and signature (auto-populated from PET-2025 registration; cannot be changed).
  5. Fill other details including department preference and domicile/reservation information.
  6. Complete the Declaration section and submit with verification code.
  7. Pay the application fee (₹25) via online mode before 11 May 2026.
  8. Download and print the submitted application form for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Only candidates who qualified PET-2025 and have been issued a score card are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates NOT domiciled in UP will not get reservation benefits.
  • Only one application to be submitted per advertisement.
  • EWS certificate must be issued between 01-04-2026 and 11-05-2026, based on FY 2025-26 income, valid for FY 2026-27.
  • OBC (non-creamy layer) certificate issued on or after 01-04-2025 only will be accepted.
  • For female candidates of UP, only caste certificate issued from father's side will be accepted.
  • Birth date as per High School (Class 10) certificate is the only accepted proof of DOB.
  • No TA/DA will be provided for document verification.
  • Exam centre, date and time will be communicated through Admit Card only; no changes in centre/date/time will be entertained.
  • UPSSSC does not communicate with candidates individually; check upsssc.gov.in regularly for all updates.
  • Application amendments allowed only up to 18 May 2026; no changes after that.

Eligibility criteria - BFUHS Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026

1) Educational qualification​

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s or Doctorate degree in any of the following (or equivalent notified by Central Government/FSSAI): Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agricultural Science, Veterinary Sciences, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemistry or Medicine.

  • Additionally, other disciplines recognised by FSSAI for Food Safety Officer, including MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BSMS, BSRC and degrees listed under “Food Technology” and “Agricultural Science” in FSSAI notifications (e.g. Food Engineering, Food Processing & Preservation, Food Safety & Quality Management, Agriculture, Dairy Technology, Horticulture, etc.).​

  • Candidate must successfully complete FSSAI‑specified training at a recognised institute after recruitment, before being notified as Food Safety Officer under Section 37 of FSS Act, 2006.​

  • Candidates having any financial interest in manufacture, import or sale of any article of food are not eligible to be appointed as FSO.​

2) Punjabi language requirement​

  • Must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject OR any equivalent exam in Punjabi language as specified by Punjab Government.

  • For Group‑C posts, must also pass a qualifying Punjabi Language test equivalent to Matric level with at least 50% marks, conducted by the recruitment agency in addition to the competitive exam; failing this disqualifies the candidate from final merit list.​

  • Certain war‑hero/defence‑personnel categories have relaxed Punjabi requirement as per Punjab Govt rules.​

3) Age limit (as on 31.12.2025)​

  • General age limit: 18 to 37 years.

  • Relaxations:

    • SC/BC: +5 years.

    • Persons with Disabilities: +10 years.

    • Ex‑Servicemen: deduct full service in Armed Forces from actual age; if resultant age does not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years, considered within age limit.

    • Punjab Govt/Boards/Corporations/Commissions/Authorities employees & all State/Central Govt employees: upper age relaxable up to 45 years.

    • Widows, divorcees and certain other categories of married women: upper age relaxable up to 40 years as per letter No. 1/50/83-5PP(1368)-3454 dated 23.04.1984.​

4) Nationality​

  • Citizen of India, or

  • Citizen of Nepal, or

  • Subject of Bhutan, or

  • Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962 to settle permanently, or

  • Person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, several East African countries, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intention of permanent settlement in India, with eligibility certificate from Govt. of Punjab, Home Affairs & Justice.​

5) Other conditions​

  • Degrees/diplomas from non‑recognised institutions or certain distance‑learning courses within India are not accepted.

  • Candidates must meet all qualifications and conditions by the last date of application.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

  • Must possess a BDS or equivalent Degree from a Medical College or Medical Institution recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must possess a valid Registration Certificate under the Dentist Act, 1948.
  • Candidates having degrees from foreign universities must possess required Conversion Certificates recognized by DCI.

Additional Requirements

  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Certificate relating to passing of the screening test conducted by the National Board of Examinations (for candidates from foreign universities)
  • Odia language test pass certificate, or must pass the required Odia examination within 4 years of joining service

Odia Language Requirement

Candidate must be able to read, write, and speak Odia and must have fulfilled any one of the following:

  • Passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject; OR
  • Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR
  • Passed in Odia as language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR
  • Passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department.

Proviso: If a candidate has not passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject, he/she shall be required to pass the examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha within 4 years of joining service. Failing this, no further increment will be sanctioned and promotion to Group-A (Senior Branch) will not be allowed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Candidate must not have been born earlier than 02 January 1984 and not later than 01 January 2005.

  • A candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of upper age relaxation, whichever is more beneficial.
  • Exception: PwBD candidates belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories shall be eligible for 15 years cumulative age relaxation.
  • Date of birth in High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will only be accepted.
  • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Salary & Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-12, Cell-1 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 and will also be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA) and other admissible allowances as sanctioned by the Government from time to time.

  • Refunds will be processed to the original mode of payment used at the time of transaction.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the online application form for refund in case of technical glitches.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Selection Process

The selection shall be made on the basis of a Written Test as per the Odisha Medical Services (Method of Recruitment and Conditions of Service of Dental Surgeons) Rules, 2022 along with Amendment Rules, 2025.

Merit List Preparation

  • The Commission shall prepare a list of candidates in order of merit on the basis of the Written Test equal to the number of advertised vacancies.
  • If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the candidate securing higher marks in the BDS Examination will rank higher.
  • If marks in the BDS Examination are also equal, the candidate older in age will be placed above the younger candidate.
  • The recommendation list shall remain valid for one year from the date of recommendation or till the next recruitment is made by the Commission.
  • A Sports Person must secure the qualifying marks of his/her category for inclusion in the merit list.

Answer Key & Result

  • Provisional Answer Keys shall be uploaded on the website within 10 days of examination.
  • Candidates can submit objections/suggestions against the provisional answer key.
  • Candidates who do not challenge the provisional answer key shall forfeit their right to agitate the matter later.
  • Cut-off marks, answer keys, and individual marks will be declared only after publication of the final result and select list.

  3. Click on the Apply Online link for Dental Surgeon recruitment from 17.03.2026 to 17.04.2026 (5:00 PM).
  4. Read detailed instructions available on the OPSC portal.
  5. Complete online registration to obtain a unique Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN).
  6. Fill the automated online application form with accurate personal, contact, category, educational, registration, Odia test, and bank details.
  7. Upload scanned copies of required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  8. Upload recent passport size photograph, full signature, and left-hand thumb impression.
  9. Pay the examination fee online, if applicable.
  10. Verify all details carefully before final submission.
  11. Submit the application form successfully.
  12. Take a printout of the finally submitted application form for future reference.

Important Guidelines

  • Applications submitted through offline mode, email, or post will not be accepted.
  • Uploaded documents must be clearly visible; otherwise, the application may be rejected.
  • Keep at least four copies of the same passport size photograph used in the application.
  • Ensure all details are correct because the application process is automated and system driven.

How to Apply for OPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted in online mode only through https://opsc.gov.in from 17 March 2026 to 17 April 2026 (5:00 PM).

  • The Admit Card will be uploaded on the OPSC website before the exam date.
  • Candidates must download and produce the admit card at the examination centre.
  • No separate communication will be made for admit card issuance.
  • Notice for document verification shall also be uploaded on the OPSC website.
  • Candidates qualified in the written exam must bring hard copy of the online application along with self-attested copies and originals of all required certificates for verification.
  • Each document copy must mention: “Submitted by me and Certified as genuine and has not been cancelled” with full signature and date.
